<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">io</span>::{
    <span class="ident">stdin</span>,
    <span class="ident">stdout</span>,
    <span class="ident">Write</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">linefeed</span>::{
    <span class="ident">DefaultTerminal</span>,
    <span class="ident">Interface</span>,
    <span class="ident">ReadResult</span>,
    <span class="ident">Signal</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">termion</span>::{
    <span class="ident">color</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">InputResult</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">command_parser</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Command</span>,
    <span class="ident">command</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">failure</span>::<span class="ident">Error</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Starting prompt</span>
<span class="kw">const</span> <span class="ident">DEFAULT_PROMPT</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="ident">str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">&quot;mentat=&gt; &quot;</span>;
<span class="doccomment">/// Prompt when further input is being read</span>
<span class="comment">// TODO: Should this actually reflect the current open brace?</span>
<span class="kw">const</span> <span class="ident">MORE_PROMPT</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="ident">str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">&quot;mentat.&gt; &quot;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Possible results from reading input from `InputReader`</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">InputResult</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// mentat command as input; (name, rest of line)</span>
    <span class="ident">MetaCommand</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>),
    <span class="doccomment">/// An empty line</span>
    <span class="ident">Empty</span>,
    <span class="doccomment">/// Needs more input</span>
    <span class="ident">More</span>,
    <span class="doccomment">/// End of file reached</span>
    <span class="ident">Eof</span>,
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Reads input from `stdin`</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">InputReader</span> {
    <span class="ident">buffer</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>,
    <span class="ident">interface</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Interface</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">DefaultTerminal</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
    <span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span> {
    <span class="comment">// We&#39;ve received some text that we should interpret as a new command, or</span>
    <span class="comment">// as part of the current command.</span>
    <span class="ident">TextInput</span>(<span class="ident">String</span>),
    <span class="comment">// We were interrupted, if we have a current command we should clear it,</span>
    <span class="comment">// otherwise we should exit. Currently can only be generated by reading from</span>
    <span class="comment">// a terminal (and not by reading from stdin).</span>
    <span class="ident">Interrupt</span>,
    <span class="comment">// We hit the end of the file, there was an error getting user input, or</span>
    <span class="comment">// something else happened that means we should exit.</span>
    <span class="ident">Quit</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">InputReader</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Constructs a new `InputReader` reading from `stdin`.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">interface</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Interface</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">DefaultTerminal</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">InputReader</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">interface</span> {
            <span class="comment">// It&#39;s fine to fail to load history.</span>
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">p</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">history_file_path</span>();
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">loaded</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>.<span class="ident">load_history</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">p</span>);
            <span class="macro">debug</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;history read from {}: {}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">p</span>.<span class="ident">display</span>(), <span class="ident">loaded</span>.<span class="ident">is_ok</span>());

            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">r</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>.<span class="ident">lock_reader</span>();
            <span class="comment">// Handle SIGINT (Ctrl-C)</span>
            <span class="ident">r</span>.<span class="ident">set_report_signal</span>(<span class="ident">Signal</span>::<span class="ident">Interrupt</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>);
            <span class="ident">r</span>.<span class="ident">set_word_break_chars</span>(<span class="string">&quot; \t\n!\&quot;#$%&amp;&#39;(){}*+,-./:;&lt;=&gt;?@[\\]^`&quot;</span>);
        }

        <span class="ident">InputReader</span>{
            <span class="ident">buffer</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(),
            <span class="ident">interface</span>,
            <span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span>: <span class="prelude-val">None</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Returns whether the `InputReader` is reading from a TTY.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">is_tty</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">interface</span>.<span class="ident">is_some</span>()
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Reads a single command, item, or statement from `stdin`.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Returns `More` if further input is required for a complete result.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// In this case, the input received so far is buffered internally.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">read_input</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">InputResult</span>, <span class="ident">Error</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">prompt</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span>.<span class="ident">is_some</span>() { <span class="ident">MORE_PROMPT</span> } <span class="kw">else</span> { <span class="ident">DEFAULT_PROMPT</span> };
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">prompt</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{blue}{prompt}{reset}&quot;</span>,
                             <span class="ident">blue</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">color</span>::<span class="ident">Fg</span>(::<span class="ident">BLUE</span>),
                             <span class="ident">prompt</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">prompt</span>,
                             <span class="ident">reset</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">color</span>::<span class="ident">Fg</span>(<span class="ident">color</span>::<span class="ident">Reset</span>));
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">line</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">read_line</span>(<span class="ident">prompt</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>()) {
            <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">TextInput</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">s</span>,
            <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Interrupt</span> <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span>.<span class="ident">is_some</span>() <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">clear</span>();
                <span class="comment">// Move to the next line, so that our next prompt isn&#39;t on top</span>
                <span class="comment">// of the previous.</span>
                <span class="macro">println</span><span class="macro">!</span>();
                <span class="ident">String</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>()
            },
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Eof</span>),
        };

        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">push</span>(<span class="string">&#39;\n&#39;</span>);
        }

        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">push_str</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">line</span>);

        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Empty</span>);
        }

        <span class="comment">// if we have a command in process (i.e. an incomplete query or transaction),</span>
        <span class="comment">// then we already know which type of command it is and so we don&#39;t need to parse the</span>
        <span class="comment">// command again, only the content, which we do later.</span>
        <span class="comment">// Therefore, we add the newly read in line to the existing command args.</span>
        <span class="comment">// If there is no in process command, we parse the read in line as a new command.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span> {
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">QueryPrepared</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">args</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">QueryPrepared</span>(<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>() <span class="op">+</span> <span class="string">&quot;\n&quot;</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">line</span>))
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Query</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">args</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Query</span>(<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>() <span class="op">+</span> <span class="string">&quot;\n&quot;</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">line</span>))
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Transact</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">args</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Transact</span>(<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>() <span class="op">+</span> <span class="string">&quot;\n&quot;</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">line</span>))
            },
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="ident">command</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>)
            },
        };

        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">cmd</span> {
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">cmd</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">cmd</span> {
                    <span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Query</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">|</span>
                    <span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">QueryPrepared</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">|</span>
                    <span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">Transact</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">|</span>
                    <span class="ident">Command</span>::<span class="ident">QueryExplain</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">cmd</span>.<span class="ident">is_complete</span>() <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// A query or transact is complete if it contains a valid EDN.</span>
                        <span class="comment">// if the command is not complete, ask for more from the REPL and remember</span>
                        <span class="comment">// which type of command we&#39;ve found here.</span>
                        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">cmd</span>);
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">More</span>)
                    },
                    <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">entry</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>();
                        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">clear</span>();
                        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">add_history</span>(<span class="ident">entry</span>);
                        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">InputResult</span>::<span class="ident">MetaCommand</span>(<span class="ident">cmd</span>))
                    }
                }
            },
            <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">entry</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>();
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">buffer</span>.<span class="ident">clear</span>();
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">add_history</span>(<span class="ident">entry</span>);
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">in_process_cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;
                <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>)
            },
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">read_line</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">prompt</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">interface</span> {
            <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">r</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="ident">r</span>.<span class="ident">set_prompt</span>(<span class="ident">prompt</span>);
                <span class="ident">r</span>.<span class="ident">read_line</span>().<span class="ident">ok</span>().<span class="ident">map_or</span>(<span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Quit</span>, <span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">line</span><span class="op">|</span>
                    <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">line</span> {
                        <span class="ident">ReadResult</span>::<span class="ident">Input</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">TextInput</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>),
                        <span class="ident">ReadResult</span>::<span class="ident">Signal</span>(<span class="ident">Signal</span>::<span class="ident">Interrupt</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span>
                            <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Interrupt</span>,
                        <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Quit</span>,
                    })

            },
            <span class="prelude-val">None</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">print</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">prompt</span>);
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">stdout</span>().<span class="ident">flush</span>().<span class="ident">is_err</span>() {
                    <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Quit</span>;
                }
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">read_stdin</span>()
            },
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">read_stdin</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">s</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">String</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>();

        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">stdin</span>().<span class="ident">read_line</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">s</span>) {
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="number">0</span>) <span class="op">|</span> <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">Quit</span>,
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">ends_with</span>(<span class="string">&quot;\n&quot;</span>) {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">len</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">-</span> <span class="number">1</span>;
                    <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">truncate</span>(<span class="ident">len</span>);
                }
                <span class="ident">UserAction</span>::<span class="ident">TextInput</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>)
            },
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">add_history</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">line</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>) {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">interface</span> {
            <span class="ident">interface</span>.<span class="ident">add_history</span>(<span class="ident">line</span>);
        }
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">save_history</span>();
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">save_history</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> () {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">interface</span> {
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">p</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">history_file_path</span>();
            <span class="comment">// It&#39;s okay to fail to save history.</span>
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">saved</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">interface</span>.<span class="ident">save_history</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">p</span>);
            <span class="macro">debug</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;history saved to {}: {}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">p</span>.<span class="ident">display</span>(), <span class="ident">saved</span>.<span class="ident">is_ok</span>());
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">static</span> <span class="ident">HISTORY_FILE_PATH</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">&quot;.mentat_history&quot;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// The Mentat CLI stores input history in a readline-compatible file like &quot;~/.mentat_history&quot;.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// This accords with main other tools which prefix with &quot;.&quot; and suffix with &quot;_history&quot;: lein,</span>

<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">history_file_path</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">PathBuf</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">p</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">env</span>::<span class="ident">home_dir</span>().<span class="ident">unwrap_or_default</span>();

    <span class="ident">p</span>

<span class="attribute">#![<span class="ident">allow</span>(<span class="ident">dead_code</span>)]</span>

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">collections</span>::<span class="ident">HashSet</span>;
<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">hash</span>::<span class="ident">Hash</span>;
<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">rc</span>::<span class="ident">Rc</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// An `InternSet` allows to &quot;intern&quot; some potentially large values, maintaining a single value</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// instance owned by the `InternSet` and leaving consumers with lightweight ref-counted handles to</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// the large owned value.  This can avoid expensive clone() operations.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// In Mentat, such large values might be strings or arbitrary [a v] pairs.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/String_interning for discussion.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Default</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">InternSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">T</span>: <span class="ident">Eq</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Hash</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">inner</span>: <span class="ident">HashSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">InternSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">T</span>: <span class="ident">Eq</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Hash</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">InternSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">InternSet</span> {
            <span class="ident">inner</span>: <span class="ident">HashSet</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(),
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">len</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">usize</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">inner</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>()
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Intern a value, providing a ref-counted handle to the interned value.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// use std::rc::Rc;</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// use mentat_core::intern_set::InternSet;</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// let mut s = InternSet::new();</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// let one = &quot;foo&quot;.to_string();</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// let two = Rc::new(&quot;foo&quot;.to_string());</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// let out_one = s.intern(one);</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(out_one, two);</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// // assert!(!&amp;out_one.ptr_eq(&amp;two));      // Nightly-only.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// let out_two = s.intern(two);</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(out_one, out_two);</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(1, s.inner.len());</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// // assert!(&amp;out_one.ptr_eq(&amp;out_two));   // Nightly-only.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">intern</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">R</span>: <span class="ident">Into</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>: <span class="ident">R</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">value</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>();
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">inner</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()) {
            <span class="ident">key</span>
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">inner</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">key</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>().<span class="ident">clone</span>()
        }
    }
}

                <h2>Search Tricks</h2>

                <p>
                    Prefix searches with a type followed by a colon (e.g.
                    <code>fn:</code>) to restrict the search to a given type.

                    Accepted types are: <code>fn</code>, <code>mod</code>,
                    <code>struct</code>, <code>enum</code>,
                    <code>trait</code>, <code>type</code>, <code>macro</code>,
                    and <code>const</code>.

                </p>

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">collections</span>::{
    <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">types</span>::{
    <span class="ident">ValueType</span>,
    <span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">value_type_set</span>::{
    <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>,
};

<span class="doccomment">/// Type safe representation of the possible return values from SQLite&#39;s `typeof`</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Copy</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">Hash</span>, <span class="ident">Ord</span>, <span class="ident">PartialOrd</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">SQLTypeAffinity</span> {
    <span class="ident">Null</span>,    <span class="comment">// &quot;null&quot;</span>
    <span class="ident">Integer</span>, <span class="comment">// &quot;integer&quot;</span>
    <span class="ident">Real</span>,    <span class="comment">// &quot;real&quot;</span>
    <span class="ident">Text</span>,    <span class="comment">// &quot;text&quot;</span>
    <span class="ident">Blob</span>,    <span class="comment">// &quot;blob&quot;</span>
}

<span class="comment">// Put this here rather than in `db` simply because it&#39;s widely needed.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">SQLValueType</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">value_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">accommodates_integer</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">int</span>: <span class="ident">i64</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span>;

    <span class="doccomment">/// Return a pair of the ValueTypeTag for this value type, and the SQLTypeAffinity required</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// to distinguish it from any other types that share the same tag.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Background: The tag alone is not enough to determine the type of a value, since multiple</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// ValueTypes may share the same tag (for example, ValueType::Long and ValueType::Double).</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// However, each ValueType can be determined by checking both the tag and the type&#39;s affinity.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">sql_representation</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> (<span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span>, <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">SQLTypeAffinity</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>);
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">SQLValueType</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ValueType</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">sql_representation</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> (<span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span>, <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">SQLTypeAffinity</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>     <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">1</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">4</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),

            <span class="comment">// SQLite distinguishes integral from decimal types, allowing long and double to share a tag.</span>
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>    <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">5</span>, <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SQLTypeAffinity</span>::<span class="ident">Integer</span>)),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>  <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">5</span>, <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SQLTypeAffinity</span>::<span class="ident">Real</span>)),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">String</span>  <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">10</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>    <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">11</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="number">13</span>, <span class="prelude-val">None</span>),
        }
    }

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">inline</span>]</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">value_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">sql_representation</span>().<span class="number">0</span>
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Returns true if the provided integer is in the SQLite value space of this type. For</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// example, `1` is how we encode `true`.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// use mentat_core::{ValueType, SQLValueType};</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(!ValueType::Instant.accommodates_integer(1493399581314));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(!ValueType::Instant.accommodates_integer(1493399581314000));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(ValueType::Boolean.accommodates_integer(1));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(!ValueType::Boolean.accommodates_integer(-1));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(!ValueType::Boolean.accommodates_integer(10));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// assert!(!ValueType::String.accommodates_integer(10));</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">accommodates_integer</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">int</span>: <span class="ident">i64</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="ident">Instant</span>                 <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,          <span class="comment">// Always use #inst.</span>
            <span class="ident">Long</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Double</span>           <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">true</span>,
            <span class="ident">Ref</span>                     <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">int</span> <span class="op">&gt;=</span> <span class="number">0</span>,
            <span class="ident">Boolean</span>                 <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (<span class="ident">int</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="number">0</span>) <span class="op">||</span> (<span class="ident">int</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="number">1</span>),
            <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">String</span>       <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
            <span class="ident">Keyword</span>                 <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
            <span class="ident">Uuid</span>                    <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
        }
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// We have an enum of types, `ValueType`. It can be collected into a set, `ValueTypeSet`. Each type</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// is associated with a type tag, which is how a type is represented in, e.g., SQL storage. Types</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// can share type tags, because backing SQL storage is able to differentiate between some types</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// (e.g., longs and doubles), and so distinct tags aren&#39;t necessary. That association is defined by</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `SQLValueType`. That trait similarly extends to `ValueTypeSet`, which maps a collection of types</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// into a collection of tags.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">SQLValueTypeSet</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">value_type_tags</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">has_unique_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">unique_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">SQLValueTypeSet</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span> {
    <span class="comment">// This is inefficient, but it&#39;ll do for now.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">value_type_tags</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">out</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>();
        <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">t</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
            <span class="ident">out</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">t</span>.<span class="ident">value_type_tag</span>());
        }
        <span class="ident">out</span>
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">unique_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueTypeTag</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">is_unit</span>() <span class="op">||</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">has_unique_type_tag</span>() {
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">exemplar</span>().<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">t</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">t</span>.<span class="ident">value_type_tag</span>())
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="prelude-val">None</span>
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">has_unique_type_tag</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">is_unit</span>() {
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="bool-val">true</span>;
        }

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">acc</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>();
        <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">t</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">acc</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">t</span>.<span class="ident">value_type_tag</span>()) <span class="op">&amp;&amp;</span> <span class="ident">acc</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="number">1</span> {
                <span class="comment">// We inserted a second or subsequent value.</span>
                <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>;
            }
        }
        <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">acc</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>()
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Side-effect chaining on `Result`.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">ResultEffect</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Invoke `f` if `self` is `Ok`, returning `self`.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">when_ok</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">F</span>: <span class="ident">FnOnce</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="ident">F</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span>;

    <span class="doccomment">/// Invoke `f` if `self` is `Err`, returning `self`.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">when_err</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">F</span>: <span class="ident">FnOnce</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="ident">F</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span>;
}

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ResultEffect</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">when_ok</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">F</span>: <span class="ident">FnOnce</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="ident">F</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">is_ok</span>() {

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">when_err</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">F</span>: <span class="ident">FnOnce</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="ident">F</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Declare a lazy static `ident` of type `Value::Keyword` with the given `namespace` and</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `name`.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// It may look surprising that we declare a new `lazy_static!` block rather than including</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// invocations inside an existing `lazy_static!` block.  The latter cannot be done, since macros</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// are expanded outside-in.  Looking at the `lazy_static!` source suggests that there is no harm in</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// repeating that macro, since internally a multi-`static` block is expanded into many</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// single-`static` blocks.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// TODO: take just &quot;:db.part/db&quot; and define DB_PART_DB using &quot;db.part&quot; and &quot;db&quot;.</span>
<span class="macro">macro_rules</span><span class="macro">!</span> <span class="ident">lazy_static_namespaced_keyword_value</span> (
    (<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">tag</span>:<span class="ident">ident</span>, <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">namespace</span>:<span class="ident">expr</span>, <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">name</span>:<span class="ident">expr</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (
        <span class="macro">lazy_static</span><span class="macro">!</span> {
            <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">static</span> <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">tag</span>: <span class="ident">Value</span> <span class="op">=</span> {
                <span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>(<span class="ident">symbols</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>::<span class="ident">namespaced</span>(<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">namespace</span>, <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">name</span>))
            };
        }
    )
);

<span class="doccomment">/// Witness assertions and retractions, folding (assertion, retraction) pairs into alterations.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// Assumes that no assertion or retraction will be witnessed more than once.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// This keeps track of when we see a :db/add, a :db/retract, or both :db/add and :db/retract in</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// some order.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">Hash</span>, <span class="ident">Ord</span>, <span class="ident">PartialOrd</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">asserted</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">retracted</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">altered</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, (<span class="ident">V</span>, <span class="ident">V</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Default</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">K</span>: <span class="ident">Ord</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">default</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span> {
            <span class="ident">asserted</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">retracted</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">altered</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),

    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">V</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">K</span>: <span class="ident">Ord</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="ident">K</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>: <span class="ident">V</span>, <span class="ident">added</span>: <span class="ident">bool</span>) {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">added</span> {
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">retracted_value</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">retracted</span>.<span class="ident">remove</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">key</span>) {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">altered</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>, (<span class="ident">retracted_value</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>));
            } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">asserted</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>);
            }
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">asserted_value</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">asserted</span>.<span class="ident">remove</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">key</span>) {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">altered</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>, (<span class="ident">value</span>, <span class="ident">asserted_value</span>));
            } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">retracted</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>);
            }
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">tests</span> {
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="kw">super</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">test</span>]</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">test</span>() {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">set</span>: <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">i64</span>, <span class="ident">char</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">AddRetractAlterSet</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="comment">// Assertion.</span>
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">1</span>, <span class="string">&#39;a&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>);
        <span class="comment">// Retraction.</span>
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">2</span>, <span class="string">&#39;b&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>);
        <span class="comment">// Alteration.</span>
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">3</span>, <span class="string">&#39;c&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>);
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">3</span>, <span class="string">&#39;d&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>);
        <span class="comment">// Alteration, witnessed in the with the retraction before the assertion.</span>
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">4</span>, <span class="string">&#39;e&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>);
        <span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">witness</span>(<span class="number">4</span>, <span class="string">&#39;f&#39;</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>);

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">asserted</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="ident">asserted</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="number">1</span>, <span class="string">&#39;a&#39;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">retracted</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="ident">retracted</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="number">2</span>, <span class="string">&#39;b&#39;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">altered</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="ident">altered</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="number">3</span>, (<span class="string">&#39;d&#39;</span>, <span class="string">&#39;c&#39;</span>));
        <span class="ident">altered</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="number">4</span>, (<span class="string">&#39;e&#39;</span>, <span class="string">&#39;f&#39;</span>));

        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">asserted</span>, <span class="ident">asserted</span>);
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">retracted</span>, <span class="ident">retracted</span>);
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">set</span>.<span class="ident">altered</span>, <span class="ident">altered</span>);

<span class="doccomment">/// Represents a *datom* (assertion) in the store.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>,<span class="ident">Debug</span>,<span class="ident">Eq</span>,<span class="ident">Hash</span>,<span class="ident">Ord</span>,<span class="ident">PartialOrd</span>,<span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">Datom</span> {
    <span class="comment">// TODO: generalize this.</span>
    <span class="ident">e</span>: <span class="ident">EntidOrIdent</span>,

<span class="doccomment">/// Represents a set of datoms (assertions) in the store.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// To make comparision easier, we deterministically order.  The ordering is the ascending tuple</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ordering determined by `(e, a, (value_type_tag, v), tx)`, where `value_type_tag` is an internal</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// value that is not exposed but is deterministic.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">Datoms</span>(<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Datom</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>);

<span class="doccomment">/// Represents an ordered sequence of transactions in the store.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// To make comparision easier, we deterministically order.  The ordering is the ascending tuple</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ordering determined by `(e, a, (value_type_tag, v), tx, added)`, where `value_type_tag` is an</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// internal value that is not exposed but is deterministic, and `added` is ordered such that</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// retracted assertions appear before added assertions.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">Transactions</span>(<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Datoms</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>);

<span class="doccomment">/// Represents the fulltext values in the store.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">FulltextValues</span>(<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">i64</span>, <span class="ident">String</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>);

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Datom</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">into_edn</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">f</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">entid</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">EntidOrIdent</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span> {
            <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">entid</span> {
                <span class="ident">EntidOrIdent</span>::<span class="ident">Entid</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">y</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Integer</span>(<span class="ident">y</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()),
                <span class="ident">EntidOrIdent</span>::<span class="ident">Ident</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">y</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>(<span class="ident">y</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()),
            }
        };

<span class="doccomment">/// Return `false` if the given attribute will not change the metadata: recognized idents, schema,</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// partitions in the partition map.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">might_update_metadata</span>(<span class="ident">attribute</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
    <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">attribute</span> <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">DB_DOC</span> {
        <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>
    }
    <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">attribute</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Idents.</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_IDENT</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="comment">// Schema.</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_CARDINALITY</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_DOC</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_FULLTEXT</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_INDEX</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_IS_COMPONENT</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_UNIQUE</span> <span class="op">|</span>
        <span class="ident">DB_VALUE_TYPE</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span>
            <span class="bool-val">true</span>,
        <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
    }
}

    };

<span class="attribute">#![<span class="ident">allow</span>(<span class="ident">dead_code</span>)]</span>

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">failure</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Backtrace</span>,
    <span class="ident">Context</span>,
    <span class="ident">Fail</span>,

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">collections</span>::{

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>;

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">entities</span>::{

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::{
    <span class="ident">KnownEntid</span>,

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">types</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
    <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>,
    <span class="ident">ValueType</span>,

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_export</span>]</span>
<span class="macro">macro_rules</span><span class="macro">!</span> <span class="ident">bail</span> {
    (<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">e</span>:<span class="ident">expr</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> (
        <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">e</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>());
    )
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">result</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">DbError</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="comment">// TODO Error/ErrorKind pair</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">CardinalityConflict</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// A cardinality one attribute has multiple assertions `[e a v1], [e a v2], ...`.</span>
    <span class="ident">CardinalityOneAddConflict</span> {
        <span class="ident">e</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
        <span class="ident">a</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
        <span class="ident">vs</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    },

    <span class="doccomment">/// A datom has been both asserted and retracted, like `[:db/add e a v]` and `[:db/retract e a v]`.</span>
    <span class="ident">AddRetractConflict</span> {
        <span class="ident">e</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
        <span class="ident">a</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
        <span class="ident">vs</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    },
}

<span class="comment">// TODO Error/ErrorKind pair</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>, <span class="ident">Fail</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">SchemaConstraintViolation</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// A transaction tried to assert datoms where one tempid upserts to two (or more) distinct</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// entids.</span>
    <span class="ident">ConflictingUpserts</span> {
        <span class="doccomment">/// A map from tempid to the entids it would upsert to.</span>
        <span class="doccomment">///</span>
        <span class="doccomment">/// In the future, we might even be able to attribute the upserts to particular (reduced)</span>
        <span class="doccomment">/// datoms, i.e., to particular `[e a v]` triples that caused the constraint violation.</span>
        <span class="doccomment">/// Attributing constraint violations to input data is more difficult to the multiple</span>
        <span class="doccomment">/// rewriting passes the input undergoes.</span>
        <span class="ident">conflicting_upserts</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempId</span>, <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">KnownEntid</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
    },

    <span class="doccomment">/// A transaction tried to assert a datom or datoms with the wrong value `v` type(s).</span>
    <span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span> {
        <span class="doccomment">/// The key (`[e a v]`) has an invalid value `v`: it is not of the expected value type.</span>
        <span class="ident">conflicting_datoms</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>), <span class="ident">ValueType</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>
    },

    <span class="doccomment">/// A transaction tried to assert datoms that don&#39;t observe the schema&#39;s cardinality constraints.</span>
    <span class="ident">CardinalityConflicts</span> {
        <span class="ident">conflicts</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">CardinalityConflict</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    },
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Display</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">SchemaConstraintViolation</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">fmt</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Formatter</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">SchemaConstraintViolation</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">ConflictingUpserts</span> { <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">conflicting_upserts</span> } <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;conflicting upserts:&quot;</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="ident">tempid</span>, <span class="ident">entids</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">conflicting_upserts</span> {
                    <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;  tempid {:?} upserts to {:?}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">tempid</span>, <span class="ident">entids</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                }
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span> { <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">conflicting_datoms</span> } <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;type disagreements:&quot;</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">datom</span>, <span class="ident">expected_type</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">conflicting_datoms</span> {
                    <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;  expected value of type {} but got datom [{} {} {:?}]&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">expected_type</span>, <span class="ident">datom</span>.<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="ident">datom</span>.<span class="number">1</span>, <span class="ident">datom</span>.<span class="number">2</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                }
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">CardinalityConflicts</span> { <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">conflicts</span> } <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;cardinality conflicts:&quot;</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">conflict</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">conflicts</span> {
                    <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;  {:?}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">conflict</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                }
                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
            },
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Copy</span>, <span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Fail</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">InputError</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Map notation included a bad `:db/id` value.</span>
    <span class="ident">BadDbId</span>,

    <span class="doccomment">/// A value place cannot be interpreted as an entity place (for example, in nested map</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// notation).</span>
    <span class="ident">BadEntityPlace</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Display</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">InputError</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">fmt</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Formatter</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">InputError</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">BadDbId</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;:db/id in map notation must either not be present or be an entid, an ident, or a tempid&quot;</span>)
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">BadEntityPlace</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">writeln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">f</span>, <span class="string">&quot;cannot convert value place into entity place&quot;</span>)
            },
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Debug</span>)]</span>

    <span class="doccomment">/// An entid-&gt;ident mapping failed.</span>
