<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TypedValueOr</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Either</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>, <span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempId</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TempIdMap</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">HashMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span>, <span class="ident">KnownEntid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">LookupRef</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">AVPair</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Internal representation of an entid on its way to resolution.  We either have the simple case (a</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// numeric entid), a lookup-ref that still needs to be resolved (an atomized [a v] pair), or a temp</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ID that needs to be upserted or allocated (an atomized tempid).</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>,<span class="ident">Debug</span>,<span class="ident">Eq</span>,<span class="ident">Hash</span>,<span class="ident">Ord</span>,<span class="ident">PartialOrd</span>,<span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span> {
    <span class="ident">LookupRef</span>(<span class="ident">LookupRef</span>),
    <span class="ident">TempId</span>(<span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span>)
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TermWithTempIdsAndLookupRefs</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Term</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">KnownEntidOr</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValueOr</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TermWithTempIds</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Term</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">KnownEntidOr</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValueOr</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TermWithoutTempIds</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Term</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">KnownEntid</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">Population</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TermWithTempIds</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TermWithTempIds</span> {
    <span class="comment">// These have no tempids by definition, and just need to be unwrapped.  This operation might</span>
    <span class="comment">// also be called &quot;lowering&quot; or &quot;level lowering&quot;, but the concept of &quot;unwrapping&quot; is common in</span>
    <span class="comment">// Rust and seems appropriate here.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">unwrap</span>(<span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">TermWithoutTempIds</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="ident">Term</span>::<span class="ident">AddOrRetract</span>(<span class="ident">op</span>, <span class="ident">Left</span>(<span class="ident">n</span>), <span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">Left</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Term</span>::<span class="ident">AddOrRetract</span>(<span class="ident">op</span>, <span class="ident">n</span>, <span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">v</span>),
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="macro">unreachable</span><span class="macro">!</span>(),
        }
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Given a `KnownEntidOr` or a `TypedValueOr`, replace any internal `LookupRef` with the entid from</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// the given map.  Fail if any `LookupRef` cannot be replaced.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `lift` allows to specify how the entid found is mapped into the output type.  (This could</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// also be an `Into` or `From` requirement.)</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// The reason for this awkward expression is that we&#39;re parameterizing over the _type constructor_</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// (`EntidOr` or `TypedValueOr`), which is not trivial to express in Rust.  This only works because</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// they&#39;re both the same `Result&lt;...&gt;` type with different parameterizations.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">replace_lookup_ref</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">U</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">lookup_map</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AVMap</span>, <span class="ident">desired_or</span>: <span class="ident">Either</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">lift</span>: <span class="ident">U</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Either</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">TempIdHandle</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">U</span>: <span class="ident">FnOnce</span>(<span class="ident">Entid</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">T</span> {
    <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">desired_or</span> {
        <span class="ident">Left</span>(<span class="ident">desired</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Left</span>(<span class="ident">desired</span>)), <span class="comment">// N.b., must unwrap here -- the ::Left types are different!</span>
        <span class="ident">Right</span>(<span class="ident">other</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
            <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">other</span> {
                <span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span>::<span class="ident">TempId</span>(<span class="ident">t</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Right</span>(<span class="ident">t</span>)),
                <span class="ident">LookupRefOrTempId</span>::<span class="ident">LookupRef</span>(<span class="ident">av</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">lookup_map</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">av</span>)
                    .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">x</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">lift</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">x</span>)).<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="ident">Left</span>)
                    <span class="comment">// XXX TODO: fix this error kind!</span>
                    .<span class="ident">ok_or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">DbErrorKind</span>::<span class="ident">UnrecognizedIdent</span>(<span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;couldn&#39;t lookup [a v]: {:?}&quot;</span>, (<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">av</span>).<span class="ident">clone</span>())).<span class="ident">into</span>()),
            }
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Default</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">AddAndRetract</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="ident">add</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="ident">retract</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="comment">// A trie-like structure mapping a -&gt; e -&gt; v that prefix compresses and makes uniqueness constraint</span>
<span class="comment">// checking more efficient.  BTree* for deterministic errors.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">AEVTrie</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span> <span class="ident">Attribute</span>), <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AddAndRetract</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Prepare an SQL `VALUES` block, like (?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?).</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// The number of values per tuple determines  `(?, ?, ?)`.  The number of tuples determines `(...), (...)`.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// # Examples</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ```rust</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// # use mentat_db::{repeat_values};</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(repeat_values(1, 3), &quot;(?), (?), (?)&quot;.to_string());</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(repeat_values(3, 1), &quot;(?, ?, ?)&quot;.to_string());</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// assert_eq!(repeat_values(2, 2), &quot;(?, ?), (?, ?)&quot;.to_string());</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">repeat_values</span>(<span class="ident">values_per_tuple</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>, <span class="ident">tuples</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">String</span> {
    <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">values_per_tuple</span> <span class="op">&gt;=</span> <span class="number">1</span>);
    <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">tuples</span> <span class="op">&gt;=</span> <span class="number">1</span>);
    <span class="comment">// Like &quot;(?, ?, ?)&quot;.</span>
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">inner</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;({})&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">repeat</span>(<span class="string">&quot;?&quot;</span>).<span class="ident">take</span>(<span class="ident">values_per_tuple</span>).<span class="ident">join</span>(<span class="string">&quot;, &quot;</span>));
    <span class="comment">// Like &quot;(?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?)&quot;.</span>
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">String</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">repeat</span>(<span class="ident">inner</span>).<span class="ident">take</span>(<span class="ident">tuples</span>).<span class="ident">join</span>(<span class="string">&quot;, &quot;</span>);
    <span class="ident">values</span>
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Map from found [e a v] to expected type.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>), <span class="ident">ValueType</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// Ensure that the given terms type check.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// We try to be maximally helpful by yielding every malformed datom, rather than only the first.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// In the future, we might change this choice, or allow the consumer to specify the robustness of</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// the type checking desired, since there is a cost to providing helpful diagnostics.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">type_disagreements</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">aev_trie</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AEVTrie</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>: <span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">TypeDisagreements</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();

        <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">e</span>, <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">evs</span> {
            <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">v</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">add</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>().<span class="ident">chain</span>(<span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">retract</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>()) {

<span class="doccomment">/// Ensure that the given terms obey the cardinality restrictions of the given schema.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// That is, ensure that any cardinality one attribute is added with at most one distinct value for</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// any specific entity (although that one value may be repeated for the given entity).</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// It is an error to:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - add two distinct values for the same cardinality one attribute and entity in a single transaction</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - add and remove the same values for the same attribute and entity in a single transaction</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// We try to be maximally helpful by yielding every malformed set of datoms, rather than just the</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// first set, or even the first conflict.  In the future, we might change this choice, or allow the</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// consumer to specify the robustness of the cardinality checking desired.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">cardinality_conflicts</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">aev_trie</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AEVTrie</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">CardinalityConflict</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">errors</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="macro">vec</span><span class="macro">!</span>[];

    <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>(<span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">attribute</span>), <span class="ident">evs</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">aev_trie</span> {
        <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">e</span>, <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">evs</span> {
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">attribute</span>.<span class="ident">multival</span> <span class="op">&amp;&amp;</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">add</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="number">1</span> {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">vs</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">add</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>();
                <span class="ident">errors</span>.<span class="ident">push</span>(<span class="ident">CardinalityConflict</span>::<span class="ident">CardinalityOneAddConflict</span> { <span class="ident">e</span>, <span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">vs</span> });
            }

            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">vs</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw">_</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">retract</span>.<span class="ident">intersection</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">ars</span>.<span class="ident">add</span>).<span class="ident">cloned</span>().<span class="ident">collect</span>();
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">vs</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
                <span class="ident">errors</span>.<span class="ident">push</span>(<span class="ident">CardinalityConflict</span>::<span class="ident">AddRetractConflict</span> { <span class="ident">e</span>, <span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">vs</span> })
            }
        }
    }

    <span class="ident">errors</span>
}

    <span class="ident">notify_fn</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Fn</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>, <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Sync</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
    <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TxObserver</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">F</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span>, <span class="ident">notify_fn</span>: <span class="ident">F</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">TxObserver</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">F</span>: <span class="ident">Fn</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>, <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">+</span> <span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Sync</span> {
        <span class="ident">TxObserver</span> {
            <span class="ident">notify_fn</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">notify_fn</span>)),
            <span class="ident">attributes</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">applicable_reports</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;r</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">reports</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;r</span> <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;r</span> <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;r</span> <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">reports</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>()
               .<span class="ident">filter</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>(<span class="ident">_txid</span>, <span class="ident">attrs</span>)<span class="op">|</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">attributes</span>.<span class="ident">is_disjoint</span>(<span class="ident">attrs</span>))
               .<span class="ident">collect</span>()

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">notify</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>, <span class="ident">reports</span>: <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) {
        (<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">notify_fn</span>)(<span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">reports</span>);
    }

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">TxCommand</span> {
    <span class="ident">reports</span>: <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="ident">observers</span>: <span class="ident">Weak</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TxObserver</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TxCommand</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">observers</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TxObserver</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">reports</span>: <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">TxCommand</span> {
            <span class="ident">reports</span>,
            <span class="ident">observers</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span>::<span class="ident">downgrade</span>(<span class="ident">observers</span>),
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">TxCommand</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">execute</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>) {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>.<span class="ident">upgrade</span>().<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">observers</span><span class="op">|</span> {
            <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">observer</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">observers</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">applicable_reports</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">observer</span>.<span class="ident">applicable_reports</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">reports</span>);
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">applicable_reports</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
                    <span class="ident">observer</span>.<span class="ident">notify</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">applicable_reports</span>);
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">TxObservationService</span> {
    <span class="ident">observers</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TxObserver</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="ident">executor</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Sender</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TxObservationService</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">TxObservationService</span> {
            <span class="ident">observers</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">IndexMap</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>()),
            <span class="ident">executor</span>: <span class="prelude-val">None</span>,

    }

    <span class="comment">// For testing purposes</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">is_registered</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">String</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>.<span class="ident">contains_key</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>)
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">register</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">observer</span>: <span class="ident">Arc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TxObserver</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) {
        <span class="ident">Arc</span>::<span class="ident">make_mut</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>).<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>, <span class="ident">observer</span>);
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">deregister</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">key</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">String</span>) {
        <span class="ident">Arc</span>::<span class="ident">make_mut</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>).<span class="ident">remove</span>(<span class="ident">key</span>);
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">has_observers</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="op">!</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>()
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">in_progress_did_commit</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">txes</span>: <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) {
        <span class="comment">// Don&#39;t spawn a thread only to say nothing.</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">has_observers</span>() {
            <span class="kw">return</span>;
        }

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">executor</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">executor</span>.<span class="ident">get_or_insert_with</span>(<span class="op">||</span> {
            <span class="kw">let</span> (<span class="ident">tx</span>, <span class="ident">rx</span>): (<span class="ident">Sender</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">Receiver</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">channel</span>();
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">worker</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">CommandExecutor</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">rx</span>);

            <span class="ident">thread</span>::<span class="ident">spawn</span>(<span class="kw">move</span> <span class="op">||</span> {
                <span class="ident">worker</span>.<span class="ident">main</span>();
            });

            <span class="ident">tx</span>
        });

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">cmd</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">TxCommand</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">observers</span>, <span class="ident">txes</span>));
        <span class="ident">executor</span>.<span class="ident">send</span>(<span class="ident">cmd</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Drop</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">TxObservationService</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">drop</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>) {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">executor</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">InProgressObserverTransactWatcher</span> {
    <span class="ident">collected_attributes</span>: <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">txes</span>: <span class="ident">IndexMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">InProgressObserverTransactWatcher</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">InProgressObserverTransactWatcher</span> {
        <span class="ident">InProgressObserverTransactWatcher</span> {
            <span class="ident">collected_attributes</span>: <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">txes</span>: <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TransactWatcher</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">InProgressObserverTransactWatcher</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">datom</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">_op</span>: <span class="ident">OpType</span>, <span class="ident">_e</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">a</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">_v</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>) {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">collected_attributes</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">a</span>);
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">done</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">t</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">_schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">collected_attributes</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">mem</span>::<span class="ident">replace</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">collected_attributes</span>, <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>());
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">txes</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">t</span>, <span class="ident">collected_attributes</span>);
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }
}

<span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">CommandExecutor</span> {
    <span class="ident">receiver</span>: <span class="ident">Receiver</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">CommandExecutor</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">rx</span>: <span class="ident">Receiver</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Command</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="ident">Send</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">CommandExecutor</span> {
            <span class="ident">receiver</span>: <span class="ident">rx</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">main</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>) {
        <span class="kw">loop</span> {
            <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">receiver</span>.<span class="ident">recv</span>() {
                <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">RecvError</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="comment">// &quot;The recv operation can only fail if the sending half of a channel (or</span>
                    <span class="comment">// sync_channel) is disconnected, implying that no further messages will ever be</span>
                    <span class="comment">// received.&quot;</span>
                    <span class="comment">// No need to log here.</span>
                    <span class="kw">return</span>
                },

                <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">cmd</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="ident">cmd</span>.<span class="ident">execute</span>()
                },
            }
        }
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Map partition names to `Partition` instances.</span>

<span class="doccomment">/// Represents the metadata required to query from, or apply transactions to, a Mentat store.</span>

<span class="doccomment">/// A pair [a v] in the store.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// Used to represent lookup-refs and [TEMPID a v] upserts as they are resolved.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">AVPair</span> <span class="op">=</span> (<span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>);

<span class="doccomment">/// Map [a v] pairs to existing entids.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// Used to resolve lookup-refs and upserts.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">AVMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;a</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">HashMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;a</span> <span class="ident">AVPair</span>, <span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="comment">// represents a set of entids that are correspond to attributes</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">AttributeSet</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// A transaction report summarizes an applied transaction.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">Hash</span>, <span class="ident">Ord</span>, <span class="ident">PartialOrd</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">TxReport</span> {

    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Every string literal tempid presented to the transactor either resolves via upsert to an</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// existing entid, or is allocated a new entid.  (It is possible for multiple distinct string</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// literal tempids to all unify to a single freshly allocated entid.)</span>

}

<span class="doccomment">/// The transactor is tied to `edn::ValueAndSpan` right now, but in the future we&#39;d like to support</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `TypedValue` directly for programmatic use.  `TransactableValue` encapsulates the interface</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// value types (i.e., values in the value place) need to support to be transacted.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">TransactableValue</span>: <span class="ident">Clone</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Coerce this value place into the given type.  This is where we perform schema-aware</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// coercion, for example coercing an integral value into a ref where appropriate.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">into_typed_value</span>(<span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">value_type</span>: <span class="ident">ValueType</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

    <span class="doccomment">/// Make an entity place out of this value place.  This is where we limit values in nested maps</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// to valid entity places.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">into_entity_place</span>(<span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">EntityPlace</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="self">Self</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>;

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">as_tempid</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">TempId</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
}

<span class="comment">// A trivial interface for extracting information from a transact as it happens.</span>
<span class="comment">// We have two situations in which we need to do this:</span>
<span class="comment">//</span>
<span class="comment">// - InProgress and Conn both have attribute caches. InProgress&#39;s is different from Conn&#39;s,</span>
<span class="comment">//   because it needs to be able to roll back. These wish to see changes in a certain set of</span>
<span class="comment">//   attributes in order to synchronously update the cache during a write.</span>
<span class="comment">// - When observers are registered we want to flip some flags as writes occur so that we can</span>
<span class="comment">//   notifying them outside the transaction.</span>

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
    <span class="ident">Schema</span>,
    <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">entities</span>::{
    <span class="ident">OpType</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::{
    <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span>,
};

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">TransactWatcher</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">datom</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">op</span>: <span class="ident">OpType</span>, <span class="ident">e</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">a</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">v</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>);

    <span class="doccomment">/// Only return an error if you want to interrupt the transact!</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Called with the schema _prior to_ the transact -- any attributes or</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// attribute changes transacted during this transact are not reflected in</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// the schema.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">done</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">t</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span>;
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">NullWatcher</span>();

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">TransactWatcher</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">NullWatcher</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">datom</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">_op</span>: <span class="ident">OpType</span>, <span class="ident">_e</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">_a</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">_v</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>) {
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">done</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">_t</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">_schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">strings</span> {
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">ffi</span>::{
        <span class="ident">CString</span>,
        <span class="ident">CStr</span>
    };
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">os</span>::<span class="ident">raw</span>::<span class="ident">c_char</span>;

    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat</span>::{
        <span class="ident">Keyword</span>,
    };

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">c_char_to_string</span>(<span class="ident">cchar</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw">const</span> <span class="ident">c_char</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="ident">str</span> {
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">cchar</span>.<span class="ident">is_null</span>());
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">c_str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw">unsafe</span> { <span class="ident">CStr</span>::<span class="ident">from_ptr</span>(<span class="ident">cchar</span>) };
        <span class="ident">c_str</span>.<span class="ident">to_str</span>().<span class="ident">unwrap_or</span>(<span class="string">&quot;&quot;</span>)
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">string_to_c_char</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">r_string</span>: <span class="ident">T</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">c_char</span> <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">T</span>: <span class="ident">Into</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">String</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">CString</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">r_string</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>()).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>().<span class="ident">into_raw</span>()
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">kw_from_string</span>(<span class="ident">keyword_string</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Keyword</span> {
        <span class="comment">// TODO: validate. The input might not be a keyword!</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">attr_name</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">keyword_string</span>.<span class="ident">trim_left_matches</span>(<span class="string">&quot;:&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">parts</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">attr_name</span>.<span class="ident">split</span>(<span class="string">&quot;/&quot;</span>).<span class="ident">collect</span>();
        <span class="ident">Keyword</span>::<span class="ident">namespaced</span>(<span class="ident">parts</span>[<span class="number">0</span>], <span class="ident">parts</span>[<span class="number">1</span>])
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">log</span> {
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;android&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)))]</span>
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">ffi</span>::<span class="ident">CString</span>;

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;android&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)))]</span>
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">android</span>;

    <span class="comment">// TODO far from ideal. And, we might actually want to println in tests.</span>
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;android&quot;</span>), <span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;ios&quot;</span>)))]</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">d</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) {}

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;ios&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)))]</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">d</span>(<span class="ident">message</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) {
        <span class="macro">eprintln</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">message</span>);
    }

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">target_os</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="string">&quot;android&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">not</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)))]</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">d</span>(<span class="ident">message</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">CString</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">message</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">message</span>.<span class="ident">as_ptr</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">tag</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">CString</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="string">&quot;Mentat&quot;</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">tag</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">tag</span>.<span class="ident">as_ptr</span>();
        <span class="kw">unsafe</span> { <span class="ident">android</span>::<span class="ident">__android_log_write</span>(<span class="ident">android</span>::<span class="ident">LogLevel</span>::<span class="ident">Debug</span> <span class="kw">as</span> <span class="ident">i32</span>, <span class="ident">tag</span>, <span class="ident">message</span>) };
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">error</span> {
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="kw">super</span>::<span class="ident">strings</span>::<span class="ident">string_to_c_char</span>;
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">os</span>::<span class="ident">raw</span>::<span class="ident">c_char</span>;
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">boxed</span>::<span class="ident">Box</span>;
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Display</span>;
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">ptr</span>;

    <span class="doccomment">/// Represents an error that occurred on the mentat side. Many mentat FFI functions take a</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// `*mut ExternError` as the last argument. This is an out parameter that indicates an</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// error that occurred during that function&#39;s execution (if any).</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// For functions that use this pattern, if the ExternError&#39;s message property is null, then no</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// error occurred. If the message is non-null then it contains a string description of the</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// error that occurred.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Important: This message is allocated on the heap and it is the consumer&#39;s responsibility to</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// free it using `destroy_mentat_string`!</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// While this pattern is not ergonomic in Rust, it offers two main benefits:</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// 1. It avoids defining a large number of `Result`-shaped types in the FFI consumer, as would</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///    be required with something like an `struct ExternResult&lt;T&gt; { ok: *mut T, err:... }`</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// 2. It offers additional type safety over `struct ExternResult { ok: *mut c_void, err:... }`,</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///    which helps avoid memory safety errors.</span>
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">repr</span>(<span class="ident">C</span>)]</span>
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Debug</span>)]</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span> {
        <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">message</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">c_char</span>,
        <span class="comment">// TODO: Include an error code here.</span>
    }

    <span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Default</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span> {
        <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">default</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span> {
            <span class="ident">ExternError</span> { <span class="ident">message</span>: <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>() }
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Translate Result&lt;T, E&gt;, into something C can understand, when T is not `#[repr(C)]`</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - If `result` is `Ok(v)`, moves `v` to the heap and returns a pointer to it, and sets</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   `error` to a state indicating that no error occurred (`message` is null).</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - If `result` is `Err(e)`, returns a null pointer and stores a string representing the error</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   message (which was allocated on the heap and should eventually be freed) into</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   `error.message`</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">unsafe</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">translate_result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">result</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">error</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">T</span>
    <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">E</span>: <span class="ident">Display</span> {
        <span class="comment">// TODO: can&#39;t unwind across FFI...</span>
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">is_null</span>(), <span class="string">&quot;Error output parameter is not optional&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">error</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">error</span>;
        <span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>();
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">result</span> {
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">into_raw</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>)),
            <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">string_to_c_char</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>());
                <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>()
            }
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Translate Result&lt;Option&lt;T&gt;, E&gt; into something C can understand, when T is not `#[repr(C)]`.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - If `result` is `Ok(Some(v))`, moves `v` to the heap and returns a pointer to it, and</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   sets `error` to a state indicating that no error occurred (`message` is null).</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - If `result` is `Ok(None)` returns a null pointer, but sets `error` to a state indicating</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   that no error occurred (`message` is null).</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - If `result` is `Err(e)`, returns a null pointer and stores a string representing the error</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   message (which was allocated on the heap and should eventually be freed) into</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   `error.message`</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">unsafe</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">translate_opt_result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">result</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">error</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">T</span>
    <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">E</span>: <span class="ident">Display</span> {
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">is_null</span>(), <span class="string">&quot;Error output parameter is not optional&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">error</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">error</span>;
        <span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>();
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">result</span> {
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">into_raw</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>)),
            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="prelude-val">None</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>(),
            <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="ident">error</span>.<span class="ident">message</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">string_to_c_char</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>());
                <span class="ident">ptr</span>::<span class="ident">null_mut</span>()
            }
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Identical to `translate_result`, but with additional type checking for the case that we have</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// a `Result&lt;(), E&gt;` (which we&#39;re about to drop on the floor).</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">unsafe</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">translate_void_result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">result</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(), <span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">error</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">ExternError</span>) <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">E</span>: <span class="ident">Display</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Note that Box&lt;T&gt; guarantees that if T is zero sized, it&#39;s not heap allocated. So not</span>
        <span class="comment">// only do we never need to free the return value of this, it would be a problem if someone did.</span>
        <span class="ident">translate_result</span>(<span class="ident">result</span>, <span class="ident">error</span>);
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// A `ValueParseError` is a `combine::primitives::ParseError`-alike that implements the `Debug`,</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `Display`, and `std::error::Error` traits.  In addition, it doesn&#39;t capture references.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// This is achieved by wrapping slices of type `&amp;&#39;a [edn::Value]` in an owning type that implements</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `Display`; rather than introducing a newtype like `DisplayVec`, we re-use `edn::Value::Vector`.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">ValueParseError</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">position</span>: <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Span</span>,
    <span class="comment">// Think of this as `Vec&lt;Error&lt;edn::Value, DisplayVec&lt;edn::Value&gt;&gt;&gt;`; see above.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">combine</span>::<span class="ident">primitives</span>::<span class="ident">Error</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">ValueAndSpan</span>, <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">ValueAndSpan</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_use</span>]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">macros</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">macros</span>::{
    <span class="ident">KeywordMapParser</span>,
    <span class="ident">ResultParser</span>,
};

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">log</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">value_and_span</span>;
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">value_and_span</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Stream</span>,
};

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Debug</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ValueParseError</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">fmt</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Formatter</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="prelude-ty">Result</span> {

               <span class="string">&quot;ParseError {{ position: {:?}, errors: {:?} }}&quot;</span>,

    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">fmt</span>::<span class="ident">Display</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ValueParseError</span> {

        <span class="ident">combine</span>::<span class="ident">primitives</span>::<span class="ident">Error</span>::<span class="ident">fmt_errors</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">errors</span>, <span class="ident">f</span>)

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">error</span>::<span class="ident">Error</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">ValueParseError</span> {

<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">log</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">P</span>, <span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">p</span>: <span class="ident">P</span>, <span class="ident">msg</span>: <span class="ident">T</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Log</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">P</span>, <span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>

    <span class="ident">Log</span>(<span class="ident">p</span>, <span class="ident">msg</span>)

<span class="doccomment">/// We need a trait to define `Parser.log` and have it live outside of the `combine` crate.</span>

<span class="doccomment">/// `satisfy_unwrap!` makes it a little easier to implement a `satisfy_map`</span>

        <span class="ident">satisfy_map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">x</span>: <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">cas</span>(<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">var</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">x</span> <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">body</span> <span class="kw">else</span> { <span class="prelude-val">None</span> })
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Generate a `satisfy_map` expression that matches a `PlainSymbol`</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// value with the given name.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// We do this rather than using `combine::token` so that we don&#39;t</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// need to allocate a new `String` inside a `PlainSymbol` inside a `Value`</span>

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_export</span>]</span>
<span class="macro">macro_rules</span><span class="macro">!</span> <span class="ident">matches_plain_symbol</span> {
    (<span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">name</span>: <span class="ident">expr</span>, <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">input</span>: <span class="ident">ident</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">satisfy_map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">x</span>: <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span><span class="op">|</span> {
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">edn</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">PlainSymbol</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">s</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">x</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">name</span>() <span class="op">==</span> <span class="macro-nonterminal">$</span><span class="macro-nonterminal">name</span> {
                    <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(());
                }

            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_export</span>]</span>

<span class="doccomment">/// `assert_parses_to!` simplifies some of the boilerplate around running a</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// parser function against input and expecting a certain result.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_export</span>]</span>

<span class="doccomment">/// `assert_edn_parses_to!` simplifies some of the boilerplate around running a parser function</span>

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_export</span>]</span>

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>)]</span>
