                        <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_keywords</span>()
                    } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                        <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>)
                    }
                },

                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">any</span>()
                },

                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">BigInteger</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="comment">// Not yet implemented.</span>
                    <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">UnsupportedArgument</span>)
                },

                <span class="comment">// These don&#39;t make sense here. TODO: split FnArg into scalar and non-scalar…</span>
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Vector</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">|</span>
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">SrcVar</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">UnsupportedArgument</span>),

                <span class="comment">// These are all straightforward.</span>
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span>),
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>),
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>),
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Float</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>),
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Text</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">String</span>),
            })
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">ValueConversion</span> {
    <span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>),
    <span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>),
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Conversion of FnArgs to TypedValues.</span>
<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">ConjoiningClauses</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Convert the provided `FnArg` to a `TypedValue`.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// The conversion depends on, and can fail because of:</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - Existing known types of a variable to which this arg will be bound.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - Existing bindings of a variable `FnArg`.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">typed_value_from_arg</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span> <span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">arg</span>: <span class="ident">FnArg</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueConversion</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">ValueConversion</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">known_types</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="comment">// If this happens, it likely means the pattern has already failed!</span>
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">TypeMismatch</span> {
                <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
                <span class="ident">existing</span>: <span class="ident">known_types</span>,
                <span class="ident">desired</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">any</span>(),
            }));
        }

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">constrained_types</span>;
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">required</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">required_types</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>) {
            <span class="ident">constrained_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">known_types</span>.<span class="ident">intersection</span>(<span class="ident">required</span>);
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="ident">constrained_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">known_types</span>;
        }

        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">arg</span> {
            <span class="comment">// Longs are potentially ambiguous: they might be longs or entids.</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">EntidOrInteger</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">match</span> (<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>.<span class="ident">accommodates_integer</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>),
                       <span class="ident">constrained_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>),
                       <span class="ident">constrained_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>)) {
                    (<span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// Ambiguous: this arg could be an entid or a long.</span>
                        <span class="comment">// We default to long.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)))
                    },
                    (<span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// This can only be a ref.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)))
                    },
                    (<span class="kw">_</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// This can only be a long.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)))
                    },
                    (<span class="bool-val">false</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// This isn&#39;t a valid ref, but that&#39;s the type to which this must conform!</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">TypeMismatch</span> {
                            <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
                            <span class="ident">existing</span>: <span class="ident">known_types</span>,
                            <span class="ident">desired</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_longs</span>(),
                        }))
                    },
                    (<span class="kw">_</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// Non-overlapping type sets.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">TypeMismatch</span> {
                            <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
                            <span class="ident">existing</span>: <span class="ident">known_types</span>,
                            <span class="ident">desired</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_longs</span>(),
                        }))
                    },
                }
            },

            <span class="comment">// If you definitely want to look up an ident, do it before running the query.</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">IdentOrKeyword</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">match</span> (<span class="ident">constrained_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>),
                       <span class="ident">constrained_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>)) {
                    (<span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// Ambiguous: this could be a keyword or an ident.</span>
                        <span class="comment">// Default to keyword.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>()))
                    },
                    (<span class="bool-val">true</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// This can only be an ident. Look it up!</span>
                        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">schema</span>.<span class="ident">get_entid</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">x</span>).<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">k</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">k</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>()) {
                            <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>)),
                            <span class="prelude-val">None</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">UnresolvedIdent</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()))),
                        }
                    },
                    (<span class="bool-val">false</span>, <span class="bool-val">true</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Keyword</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>())))
                    },
                    (<span class="bool-val">false</span>, <span class="bool-val">false</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Impossible</span>(<span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">TypeMismatch</span> {
                            <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
                            <span class="ident">existing</span>: <span class="ident">known_types</span>,
                            <span class="ident">desired</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_keywords</span>(),
                        }))
                    },
                }
            },

            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="ident">in_var</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="comment">// TODO: technically you could ground an existing variable inside the query….</span>
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">input_variables</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">in_var</span>) {
                    <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">UnboundVariable</span>((<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">in_var</span>.<span class="number">0</span>).<span class="ident">clone</span>()))
                }
                <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">bound_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">in_var</span>) {
                    <span class="comment">// The type is already known if it&#39;s a bound variable….</span>
                    <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">in_value</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Val</span>(<span class="ident">in_value</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>())),
                    <span class="prelude-val">None</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// The variable is present in `:in`, but it hasn&#39;t yet been provided.</span>
                        <span class="comment">// This is a restriction we will eventually relax: we don&#39;t yet have a way</span>
                        <span class="comment">// to collect variables as part of a computed table or substitution.</span>
                        <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">UnboundVariable</span>((<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">in_var</span>.<span class="number">0</span>).<span class="ident">clone</span>()))
                    },
                }
            },

            <span class="comment">// This isn&#39;t implemented yet.</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">BigInteger</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="macro">unimplemented</span><span class="macro">!</span>(),

            <span class="comment">// These don&#39;t make sense here.</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Vector</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">|</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">SrcVar</span>(<span class="kw">_</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidGroundConstant</span>),

            <span class="comment">// These are all straightforward.</span>
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">coerce_to_typed_value</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">x</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Boolean</span>)
            },
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">coerce_to_typed_value</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">x</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>)
            },
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">coerce_to_typed_value</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">x</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>)
            },
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Float</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">coerce_to_typed_value</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">x</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>)
            },
            <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Constant</span>(<span class="ident">NonIntegerConstant</span>::<span class="ident">Text</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="macro">coerce_to_typed_value</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">x</span>, <span class="ident">known_types</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">String</span>)
            },
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">collections</span>::<span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>;

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::{
    <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>,
    <span class="ident">ValueType</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_query</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Variable</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::{
    <span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>,
    <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span>,
};

<span class="doccomment">/// Define the inputs to a query. This is in two parts: a set of values known now, and a set of</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// types known now.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// The separate map of types is to allow queries to be algebrized without full knowledge of</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// the bindings that will be used at execution time.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// When built correctly, `types` is guaranteed to contain the types of `values` -- use</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `QueryInputs::new` or `QueryInputs::with_values` to construct an instance.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Default</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">default</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
            <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">with_value_sequence</span>(<span class="ident">vals</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">vals</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>().<span class="ident">collect</span>();
        <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span>::<span class="ident">with_values</span>(<span class="ident">values</span>)
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">with_type_sequence</span>(<span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
        <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
            <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">types</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>().<span class="ident">collect</span>(),
            <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">with_values</span>(<span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
        <span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> {
            <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>().<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">val</span>)<span class="op">|</span> (<span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">val</span>.<span class="ident">value_type</span>())).<span class="ident">collect</span>(),
            <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">values</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
               <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Variable</span>, <span class="ident">TypedValue</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">QueryInputs</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Make sure that the types of the values agree with those in types, and collect.</span>
        <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="ident">var</span>, <span class="ident">v</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">t</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">v</span>.<span class="ident">value_type</span>();
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">old</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">types</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">t</span>);
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">old</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">old</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">old</span> <span class="op">!=</span> <span class="ident">t</span> {
                    <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InputTypeDisagreement</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">name</span>(), <span class="ident">old</span>, <span class="ident">t</span>));
                }
            }
        }
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">QueryInputs</span> { <span class="ident">types</span>: <span class="ident">types</span>, <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">values</span> })
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Application of predicates.</span>
<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">ConjoiningClauses</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// There are several kinds of predicates in our Datalog:</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - A limited set of binary comparison operators: &lt; &gt; &lt;= &gt;= !=.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   These are converted into SQLite binary comparisons and some type constraints.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - In the future, some predicates that are implemented via function calls in SQLite.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// At present we have implemented only the five built-in comparison binary operators.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">apply_predicate</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">known</span>: <span class="ident">Known</span>, <span class="ident">predicate</span>: <span class="ident">Predicate</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Because we&#39;ll be growing the set of built-in predicates, handling each differently,</span>
        <span class="comment">// and ultimately allowing user-specified predicates, we match on the predicate name first.</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">op</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Inequality</span>::<span class="ident">from_datalog_operator</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>()) {
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">apply_inequality</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>, <span class="ident">op</span>, <span class="ident">predicate</span>)
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">UnknownFunction</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()))
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">potential_types</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">fn_arg</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">fn_arg</span> {
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">v</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">known_type_set</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>)),
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="ident">fn_arg</span>.<span class="ident">potential_types</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>),
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Apply a type annotation, which is a construct like a predicate that constrains the argument</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// to be a specific ValueType.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">apply_type_anno</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">anno</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypeAnnotation</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">from_keyword</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">anno</span>.<span class="ident">value_type</span>) {
            <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">value_type</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">add_type_requirement</span>(<span class="ident">anno</span>.<span class="ident">variable</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">value_type</span>)),
            <span class="prelude-val">None</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidArgumentType</span>(<span class="ident">PlainSymbol</span>::<span class="ident">plain</span>(<span class="string">&quot;type&quot;</span>), <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">any</span>(), <span class="number">2</span>)),
        }
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// This function:</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - Resolves variables and converts types to those more amenable to SQL.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - Ensures that the predicate functions name a known operator.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - Accumulates an `Inequality` constraint into the `wheres` list.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">apply_inequality</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">known</span>: <span class="ident">Known</span>, <span class="ident">comparison</span>: <span class="ident">Inequality</span>, <span class="ident">predicate</span>: <span class="ident">Predicate</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">!=</span> <span class="number">2</span> {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidNumberOfArguments</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>(), <span class="number">2</span>));
        }

        <span class="comment">// Go from arguments -- parser output -- to columns or values.</span>
        <span class="comment">// Any variables that aren&#39;t bound by this point in the linear processing of clauses will</span>
        <span class="comment">// cause the application of the predicate to fail.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">args</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">left</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">next</span>().<span class="ident">expect</span>(<span class="string">&quot;two args&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">right</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">next</span>().<span class="ident">expect</span>(<span class="string">&quot;two args&quot;</span>);


        <span class="comment">// The types we&#39;re handling here must be the intersection of the possible types of the arguments,</span>
        <span class="comment">// the known types of any variables, and the types supported by our inequality operators.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">supported_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">comparison</span>.<span class="ident">supported_types</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">left_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">potential_types</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>.<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">left</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>
                                 .<span class="ident">intersection</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">supported_types</span>);
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">left_types</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidArgumentType</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">supported_types</span>, <span class="number">0</span>));
        }

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">right_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">potential_types</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>.<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">right</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>
                                  .<span class="ident">intersection</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">supported_types</span>);
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">right_types</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidArgumentType</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">supported_types</span>, <span class="number">1</span>));
        }

        <span class="comment">// We would like to allow longs to compare to doubles.</span>
        <span class="comment">// Do this by expanding the type sets. `resolve_numeric_argument` will</span>
        <span class="comment">// use `Long` by preference.</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">right_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>) {
            <span class="ident">right_types</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>);
        }
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">left_types</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>) {
            <span class="ident">left_types</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>);
        }

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">shared_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">left_types</span>.<span class="ident">intersection</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">right_types</span>);
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">shared_types</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="comment">// In isolation these are both valid inputs to the operator, but the query cannot</span>
            <span class="comment">// succeed because the types don&#39;t match.</span>
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">mark_known_empty</span>(
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">var</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">left</span>.<span class="ident">as_variable</span>().<span class="ident">or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">right</span>.<span class="ident">as_variable</span>()) {
                    <span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">TypeMismatch</span> {
                        <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
                        <span class="ident">existing</span>: <span class="ident">left_types</span>,
                        <span class="ident">desired</span>: <span class="ident">right_types</span>,
                    }
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>::<span class="ident">KnownTypeMismatch</span> {
                        <span class="ident">left</span>: <span class="ident">left_types</span>,
                        <span class="ident">right</span>: <span class="ident">right_types</span>,
                    }
                });
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(());
        }

        <span class="comment">// We expect the intersection to be Long, Long+Double, Double, or Instant.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">left_v</span>;
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">right_v</span>;

        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">shared_types</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Instant</span>) {
            <span class="ident">left_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_instant_argument</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">0</span>, <span class="ident">left</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
            <span class="ident">right_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_instant_argument</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">1</span>, <span class="ident">right</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
        } <span class="kw">else</span> <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">shared_types</span>.<span class="ident">is_only_numeric</span>() {
            <span class="ident">left_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_numeric_argument</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">0</span>, <span class="ident">left</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
            <span class="ident">right_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_numeric_argument</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">1</span>, <span class="ident">right</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
        } <span class="kw">else</span> <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">shared_types</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_one</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>) {
            <span class="ident">left_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_ref_argument</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>.<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">0</span>, <span class="ident">left</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
            <span class="ident">right_v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">resolve_ref_argument</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>.<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>, <span class="number">1</span>, <span class="ident">right</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">AlgebrizerError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidArgumentType</span>(<span class="ident">predicate</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">supported_types</span>, <span class="number">0</span>));
        }

        <span class="comment">// These arguments must be variables or instant/numeric constants.</span>
        <span class="comment">// TODO: static evaluation. #383.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">constraint</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">comparison</span>.<span class="ident">to_constraint</span>(<span class="ident">left_v</span>, <span class="ident">right_v</span>);
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">wheres</span>.<span class="ident">add_intersection</span>(<span class="ident">constraint</span>);
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Inequality</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">to_constraint</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">left</span>: <span class="ident">QueryValue</span>, <span class="ident">right</span>: <span class="ident">QueryValue</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">ColumnConstraint</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="ident">Inequality</span>::<span class="ident">TxAfter</span> <span class="op">|</span>
            <span class="ident">Inequality</span>::<span class="ident">TxBefore</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="comment">// TODO: both ends of the range must be inside the tx partition!</span>
                <span class="comment">// If we know the partition map -- and at this point we do, it&#39;s just</span>
                <span class="comment">// not passed to this function -- then we can generate two constraints,</span>
                <span class="comment">// or clamp a fixed value.</span>
            },
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
            },
        }

        <span class="ident">ColumnConstraint</span>::<span class="ident">Inequality</span> {
            <span class="ident">operator</span>: <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>,
            <span class="ident">left</span>: <span class="ident">left</span>,
            <span class="ident">right</span>: <span class="ident">right</span>,
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">testing</span> {
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="kw">super</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;

    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::<span class="ident">attribute</span>::<span class="ident">Unique</span>;

    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_query</span>::{
        <span class="ident">FnArg</span>,
        <span class="ident">Keyword</span>,
        <span class="ident">Pattern</span>,
        <span class="ident">PatternNonValuePlace</span>,
        <span class="ident">PatternValuePlace</span>,
        <span class="ident">PlainSymbol</span>,
        <span class="ident">Variable</span>,

    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">clauses</span>::{
        <span class="ident">add_attribute</span>,
        <span class="ident">associate_ident</span>,
        <span class="ident">ident</span>,

    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">types</span>::{
        <span class="ident">ColumnConstraint</span>,
        <span class="ident">EmptyBecause</span>,
        <span class="ident">QueryValue</span>,
    };

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">test</span>]</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Apply two patterns: a pattern and a numeric predicate.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Verify that after application of the predicate we know that the value</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// must be numeric.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">test_apply_inequality</span>() {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">cc</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ConjoiningClauses</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">schema</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Schema</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();

        <span class="ident">associate_ident</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">Keyword</span>::<span class="ident">namespaced</span>(<span class="string">&quot;foo&quot;</span>, <span class="string">&quot;bar&quot;</span>), <span class="number">99</span>);
        <span class="ident">add_attribute</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="number">99</span>, <span class="ident">Attribute</span> {
            <span class="ident">value_type</span>: <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>,
            ..<span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>()
        });

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">x</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Variable</span>::<span class="ident">from_valid_name</span>(<span class="string">&quot;?x&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">y</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Variable</span>::<span class="ident">from_valid_name</span>(<span class="string">&quot;?y&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">known</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Known</span>::<span class="ident">for_schema</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">schema</span>);
        <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">apply_parsed_pattern</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>, <span class="ident">Pattern</span> {
            <span class="ident">source</span>: <span class="prelude-val">None</span>,
            <span class="ident">entity</span>: <span class="ident">PatternNonValuePlace</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="ident">x</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()),
            <span class="ident">attribute</span>: <span class="ident">PatternNonValuePlace</span>::<span class="ident">Placeholder</span>,
            <span class="ident">value</span>: <span class="ident">PatternValuePlace</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="ident">y</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()),
            <span class="ident">tx</span>: <span class="ident">PatternNonValuePlace</span>::<span class="ident">Placeholder</span>,
        });
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">is_known_empty</span>());

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">op</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">PlainSymbol</span>::<span class="ident">plain</span>(<span class="string">&quot;&lt;&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">comp</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Inequality</span>::<span class="ident">from_datalog_operator</span>(<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="ident">name</span>()).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">apply_inequality</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>, <span class="ident">comp</span>, <span class="ident">Predicate</span> {
             <span class="ident">operator</span>: <span class="ident">op</span>,
             <span class="ident">args</span>: <span class="macro">vec</span><span class="macro">!</span>[
                <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="ident">Variable</span>::<span class="ident">from_valid_name</span>(<span class="string">&quot;?y&quot;</span>)), <span class="ident">FnArg</span>::<span class="ident">EntidOrInteger</span>(<span class="number">10</span>),
            ]}).<span class="ident">is_ok</span>());

        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">is_known_empty</span>());

        <span class="comment">// Finally, expand column bindings to get the overlaps for ?x.</span>
        <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">expand_column_bindings</span>();
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">is_known_empty</span>());

        <span class="comment">// After processing those two clauses, we know that ?y must be numeric, but not exactly</span>
        <span class="comment">// which type it must be.</span>
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="prelude-val">None</span>, <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">known_type</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">y</span>));      <span class="comment">// Not just one.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">expected</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>::<span class="ident">of_numeric_types</span>();
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">expected</span>), <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">known_types</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">y</span>));

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">clauses</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">wheres</span>;
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">clauses</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>(), <span class="number">1</span>);
        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">clauses</span>.<span class="number">0</span>[<span class="number">0</span>], <span class="ident">ColumnConstraint</span>::<span class="ident">Inequality</span> {
            <span class="ident">operator</span>: <span class="ident">Inequality</span>::<span class="ident">LessThan</span>,
            <span class="ident">left</span>: <span class="ident">QueryValue</span>::<span class="ident">Column</span>(<span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">column_bindings</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">y</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>()[<span class="number">0</span>].<span class="ident">clone</span>()),
            <span class="ident">right</span>: <span class="ident">QueryValue</span>::<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>(<span class="number">10</span>)),
        }.<span class="ident">into</span>());
    }

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">test</span>]</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Apply three patterns: an unbound pattern to establish a value var,</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// a predicate to constrain the val to numeric types, and a third pattern to conflict with the</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// numeric types and cause the pattern to fail.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">test_apply_conflict_with_numeric_range</span>() {

<span class="doccomment">/// Argument resolution.</span>
<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">ConjoiningClauses</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// Take a function argument and turn it into a `QueryValue` suitable for use in a concrete</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// constraint.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Additionally, do two things:</span>

    <span class="doccomment">/// There are several kinds of functions binding variables in our Datalog:</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// - A set of functions like `ground`, fulltext` and `get-else` that are translated into SQL</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///   `VALUES`, `MATCH`, or `JOIN`, yielding bindings.</span>

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">apply_where_fn</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">known</span>: <span class="ident">Known</span>, <span class="ident">where_fn</span>: <span class="ident">WhereFn</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Because we&#39;ll be growing the set of built-in functions, handling each differently, and</span>
        <span class="comment">// ultimately allowing user-specified functions, we match on the function name first.</span>
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">where_fn</span>.<span class="ident">operator</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>() {

            <span class="string">&quot;tx-data&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">apply_tx_data</span>(<span class="ident">known</span>, <span class="ident">where_fn</span>),

            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Avg</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="string">&quot;avg&quot;</span>,
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Count</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="string">&quot;count&quot;</span>,
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Max</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="string">&quot;max&quot;</span>,
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Min</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="string">&quot;min&quot;</span>,
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Sum</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="string">&quot;sum&quot;</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">for_function</span>(<span class="ident">function</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">QueryFunction</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">function</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">name</span>() {
            <span class="string">&quot;avg&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">Avg</span>),
            <span class="string">&quot;count&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">Count</span>),
            <span class="string">&quot;max&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">Max</span>),
            <span class="string">&quot;min&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">Min</span>),
            <span class="string">&quot;sum&quot;</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">Sum</span>),
            <span class="kw">_</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// With knowledge of the types to which a variable might be bound,</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// return a `Result` to determine whether this aggregation is suitable.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// For example, it&#39;s valid to take the `Avg` of `{Double, Long}`, invalid</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// to take `Sum` of `{Instant}`, valid to take (lexicographic) `Max` of `{String}`,</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// but invalid to take `Max` of `{Uuid, String}`.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">///</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// The returned type is the type of the result of the aggregation.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">is_applicable_to_types</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">possibilities</span>: <span class="ident">ValueTypeSet</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueType</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>() {
            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectorError</span>::<span class="ident">CannotProjectImpossibleBinding</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>))
        }

        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span> {
            <span class="comment">// One can always count results.</span>
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Count</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>),

            <span class="comment">// Only numeric types can be averaged or summed.</span>
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Avg</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">is_only_numeric</span>() {
                    <span class="comment">// The mean of a set of numeric values will always, for our purposes, be a double.</span>
                    <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>)
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectorError</span>::<span class="ident">CannotApplyAggregateOperationToTypes</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">possibilities</span>))
                }
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Sum</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">is_only_numeric</span>() {
                    <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>) {
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>)
                    } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// TODO: BigInt.</span>
                        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>)
                    }
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectorError</span>::<span class="ident">CannotApplyAggregateOperationToTypes</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">possibilities</span>))
                }
            },

            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Max</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Min</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">is_unit</span>() {
                    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">the_type</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">exemplar</span>().<span class="ident">expect</span>(<span class="string">&quot;a type&quot;</span>);
                    <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">the_type</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// These types are numerically ordered.</span>
                        <span class="ident">Double</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Long</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Instant</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">the_type</span>),

                        <span class="comment">// Boolean: false &lt; true.</span>
                        <span class="ident">Boolean</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">the_type</span>),

                        <span class="comment">// String: lexicographic order.</span>
                        <span class="ident">String</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">the_type</span>),

                        <span class="comment">// These types are unordered.</span>
                        <span class="ident">Keyword</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Ref</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Uuid</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                            <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectorError</span>::<span class="ident">CannotApplyAggregateOperationToTypes</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">possibilities</span>))
                        },
                    }
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="comment">// It cannot be empty -- we checked.</span>
                    <span class="comment">// The only types that are valid to compare cross-type are numbers.</span>
                    <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">is_only_numeric</span>() {
                        <span class="comment">// Note that if the max/min is a Long, it will be returned as a Double!</span>
                        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">possibilities</span>.<span class="ident">contains</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>) {
                            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>)
                        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                            <span class="comment">// TODO: BigInt.</span>
                            <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">ValueType</span>::<span class="ident">Long</span>)
                        }
                    } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                        <span class="macro">bail</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectorError</span>::<span class="ident">CannotApplyAggregateOperationToTypes</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">possibilities</span>))
                    }
                }
            },
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">op</span>: <span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">Variable</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">column_name</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Name</span> {
        <span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;({} {})&quot;</span>, <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="ident">to_sql</span>(), <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">name</span>())
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">use_static_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">op</span> {
            <span class="ident">Avg</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Max</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Min</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">true</span>,
            <span class="ident">Count</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Sum</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Return `true` if this aggregate can be `NULL` over 0 rows.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">is_nullable</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="self">self</span>::<span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">op</span> {
            <span class="ident">Avg</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Max</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Min</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">true</span>,
            <span class="ident">Count</span> <span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">Sum</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="bool-val">false</span>,
        }
    }
}

<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregation</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">to_simple</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregation</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">Aggregate</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">to_simple</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">!=</span> <span class="number">1</span> {
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;
        }
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>[<span class="number">0</span>]
            .<span class="ident">as_variable</span>()
            .<span class="ident">and_then</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">v</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregationOp</span>::<span class="ident">for_function</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">func</span>)
                              .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">op</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span> { <span class="ident">op</span>, <span class="ident">var</span>: <span class="ident">v</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), }))
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Returns two values:</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - The `ColumnOrExpression` to use in the query. This will always refer to other</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   variables by name; never to a datoms column.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - The known type of that value.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">projected_column_for_simple_aggregate</span>(<span class="ident">simple</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">SimpleAggregate</span>, <span class="ident">cc</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">ConjoiningClauses</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">ProjectedColumn</span>, <span class="ident">ValueType</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">known_types</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">known_type_set</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">var</span>);
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">return_type</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="ident">is_applicable_to_types</span>(<span class="ident">known_types</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">projected_column_or_expression</span> <span class="op">=</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">value</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">cc</span>.<span class="ident">bound_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">var</span>) {
            <span class="comment">// Oh, we already know the value!</span>
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">use_static_value</span>() {
                <span class="comment">// We can statically compute the aggregate result for some operators -- not count or</span>
                <span class="comment">// sum, but avg/max/min are OK.</span>
                <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>(<span class="ident">value</span>)
            } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">expression</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Expression</span>::<span class="ident">Unary</span> {
                    <span class="ident">sql_op</span>: <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="ident">to_sql</span>(),
                    <span class="ident">arg</span>: <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>(<span class="ident">value</span>),
                };
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">is_nullable</span>() {
                    <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">NullableAggregate</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">expression</span>), <span class="ident">return_type</span>)
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">Expression</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">expression</span>), <span class="ident">return_type</span>)
                }
            }
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {
            <span class="comment">// The common case: the values are bound during execution.</span>
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">name</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">VariableColumn</span>::<span class="ident">Variable</span>(<span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">var</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()).<span class="ident">column_name</span>();
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">expression</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Expression</span>::<span class="ident">Unary</span> {
                <span class="ident">sql_op</span>: <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="ident">to_sql</span>(),
                <span class="ident">arg</span>: <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">ExistingColumn</span>(<span class="ident">name</span>),
            };
            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">is_nullable</span>() {
                <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">NullableAggregate</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">expression</span>), <span class="ident">return_type</span>)
            } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                <span class="ident">ColumnOrExpression</span>::<span class="ident">Expression</span>(<span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">expression</span>), <span class="ident">return_type</span>)
            }
        };
    <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>((<span class="ident">ProjectedColumn</span>(<span class="ident">projected_column_or_expression</span>, <span class="ident">simple</span>.<span class="ident">column_name</span>()), <span class="ident">return_type</span>))
}
