    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">for_puller</span>(<span class="ident">puller</span>: <span class="ident">Puller</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span> <span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">indices</span>: <span class="ident">PullIndices</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">PullConsumer</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">PullConsumer</span> {
            <span class="ident">indices</span>: <span class="ident">indices</span>,
            <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="ident">schema</span>,
            <span class="ident">puller</span>: <span class="ident">puller</span>,
            <span class="ident">entities</span>: <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">results</span>: <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">for_template</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span> <span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">template</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullTemplate</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">PullConsumer</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;schema</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">puller</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Puller</span>::<span class="ident">prepare</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">template</span>.<span class="ident">op</span>.<span class="number">0</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>())<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">PullConsumer</span>::<span class="ident">for_puller</span>(<span class="ident">puller</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">template</span>.<span class="ident">indices</span>))

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">expand</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">bindings</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> [<span class="ident">Binding</span>]) {
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">Binding</span>::<span class="ident">Scalar</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>(<span class="ident">id</span>)) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">bindings</span>[<span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">indices</span>.<span class="ident">output_index</span>] {

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Binding</span>,
    <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>,
};

<span class="doccomment">/// The result you get from a &#39;rel&#39; query, like:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ```edn</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// [:find ?person ?name</span>
<span class="doccomment">///  :where [?person :person/name ?name]]</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// ```</span>
<span class="doccomment">///</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// There are three ways to get data out of a `RelResult`:</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - By iterating over rows as slices. Use `result.rows()`. This is efficient and is</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   recommended in two cases:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   1. If you don&#39;t need to take ownership of the resulting values (e.g., you&#39;re comparing</span>
<span class="doccomment">///      or making a modified clone).</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   2. When the data you&#39;re retrieving is cheap to clone. All scalar values are relatively</span>
<span class="doccomment">///      cheap: they&#39;re either small values or `Rc`.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - By direct reference to a row by index, using `result.row(i)`. This also returns</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   a reference.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// - By consuming the results using `into_iter`. This allocates short-lived vectors,</span>
<span class="doccomment">///   but gives you ownership of the enclosed `TypedValue`s.</span>
<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Clone</span>, <span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">PartialEq</span>, <span class="ident">Eq</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">RelResult</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">width</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>,
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">StructuredRelResult</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">RelResult</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Binding</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">RelResult</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">empty</span>(<span class="ident">width</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">RelResult</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="ident">RelResult</span> {
            <span class="ident">width</span>: <span class="ident">width</span>,
            <span class="ident">values</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(),
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">is_empty</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">bool</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">is_empty</span>()
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">row_count</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">usize</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() <span class="op">/</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">width</span>
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">rows</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">slice</span>::<span class="ident">Chunks</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">T</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// TODO: Nightly-only API `exact_chunks`. #47115.</span>
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">chunks</span>(<span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">width</span>)
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">row</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">index</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>[<span class="ident">T</span>]<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">end</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">width</span> <span class="op">*</span> (<span class="ident">index</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="number">1</span>);
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">end</span> <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">values</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>() {
            <span class="prelude-val">None</span>
        } <span class="kw">else</span> {

    }

<span class="doccomment">/// A rel projector produces a RelResult, which is a striding abstraction over a vector.</span>

        <span class="comment">// gte &#39;cos we might be querying extra columns for ordering.</span>
        <span class="comment">// The templates will take care of ignoring columns.</span>
        <span class="macro">assert</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">row</span>.<span class="ident">column_count</span>() <span class="op">&gt;=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">len</span> <span class="kw">as</span> <span class="ident">i32</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">count</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="number">0</span>;
        <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">binding</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">templates</span>

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">combine</span>(<span class="ident">spec</span>: <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">FindSpec</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">column_count</span>: <span class="ident">usize</span>, <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">elements</span>: <span class="ident">ProjectedElements</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">CombinedProjection</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Projector</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">RelProjector</span> {

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">CollProjector</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">with_template</span>(<span class="ident">spec</span>: <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">FindSpec</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">template</span>: <span class="ident">TypedIndex</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">CollProjector</span> {
        <span class="ident">CollProjector</span> {
            <span class="ident">spec</span>: <span class="ident">spec</span>,
            <span class="ident">template</span>: <span class="ident">template</span>,
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span>(<span class="kw">crate</span>) <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">combine</span>(<span class="ident">spec</span>: <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">FindSpec</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">elements</span>: <span class="ident">ProjectedElements</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">CombinedProjection</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">template</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">elements</span>.<span class="ident">templates</span>.<span class="ident">pop</span>().<span class="ident">expect</span>(<span class="string">&quot;Expected a single template&quot;</span>);
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">projector</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Box</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">CollProjector</span>::<span class="ident">with_template</span>(<span class="ident">spec</span>, <span class="ident">template</span>));

        <span class="comment">// If every column yields only one value, or if this is an aggregate query</span>
        <span class="comment">// (because by definition every column in an aggregate query is either</span>
        <span class="comment">// aggregated or is a variable _upon which we group_), then don&#39;t bother</span>
        <span class="comment">// with DISTINCT.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">already_distinct</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">elements</span>.<span class="ident">pre_aggregate_projection</span>.<span class="ident">is_some</span>() <span class="op">||</span>
                               <span class="ident">projector</span>.<span class="ident">columns</span>().<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">e</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">e</span>.<span class="ident">is_unit</span>());
        <span class="ident">elements</span>.<span class="ident">combine</span>(<span class="ident">projector</span>, <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">already_distinct</span>)
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Projector</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">CollProjector</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">project</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;stmt</span>, <span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">_schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">_sqlite</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>, <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">rows</span>: <span class="ident">Rows</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;stmt</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">QueryOutput</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">out</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw">_</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="macro">vec</span><span class="macro">!</span>[];
        <span class="kw">while</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">r</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">rows</span>.<span class="ident">next</span>() {
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">row</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">r</span><span class="question-mark">?</span>;
            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">binding</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">template</span>.<span class="ident">lookup</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">row</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
            <span class="ident">out</span>.<span class="ident">push</span>(<span class="ident">binding</span>);
        }
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">QueryOutput</span> {
            <span class="ident">spec</span>: <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">spec</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
            <span class="ident">results</span>: <span class="ident">QueryResults</span>::<span class="ident">Coll</span>(<span class="ident">out</span>),
        })
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">columns</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span> <span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Iterator</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Item</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Element</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="lifetime">&#39;s</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {

<span class="doccomment">///! A pull expression is a function.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! Its inputs are a store, a schema, and a set of bindings.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! Its output is a map whose keys are the input bindings and whose values are</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! appropriate structured values to represent the pull expression.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! For example, the pull expression:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```edn</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! (pull ?person [:person/name</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!                :person/tattoo</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!                {:person/friend [*]}])`</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! will return values shaped like:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```edn</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! {:person/name &quot;Alice&quot;                            ; Single-valued attribute</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!                                                  ; Absence: Alice has no tattoos.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!  :person/friend [                                ; Multi-valued attribute.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!    {:person/name &quot;Bob&quot;                           ; Nesting and wildcard.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!     :person/pet [&quot;Harrison&quot;, &quot;Hoppy&quot;]}]}</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! There will be one such value for each input binding.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! We fetch layers of a pull expression iteratively: all attributes at the same</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! &#39;level&#39; can be fetched at the same time and accumulated into maps.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! Those maps are wrapped in `Rc` for two reasons:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! - They might occur multiple times when projected from a `:find` query.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! - They might refer to each other (consider recursion).</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! A nested or recursive pull expression consumes values produced by earlier stages</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! (the recursion with a smaller recursion limit and a growing &#39;seen&#39; list),</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! generating another layer of mappings.</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! For example, you can imagine the nesting in the earlier pull expression being</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! decomposed into two chained expressions:</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```edn</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! (pull</span>
<span class="doccomment">///!     (pull ?person [:person/friend])</span>
<span class="doccomment">///      [*]))</span>
<span class="doccomment">///! ```</span>

<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">failure</span>;

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">macro_use</span>]</span>
<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">failure_derive</span>;

<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">mentat_query</span>;
<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">mentat_query_algebrizer</span>;
<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">mentat_query_sql</span>;
<span class="kw">extern</span> <span class="kw">crate</span> <span class="ident">mentat_sql</span>;

    <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>,

    <span class="ident">once</span>,

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_core</span>::{
    <span class="ident">Binding</span>,

    <span class="ident">ValueRc</span>,
};

<span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">mentat_db</span>::<span class="ident">cache</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">errors</span>::{
    <span class="ident">PullError</span>,
    <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span>,
};

<span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">PullResults</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">ValueRc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">StructuredMap</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>;

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">pull_attributes_for_entity</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">A</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>,
                                     <span class="ident">db</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>,
                                     <span class="ident">entity</span>: <span class="ident">Entid</span>,
                                     <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">A</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">StructuredMap</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>
    <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">A</span>: <span class="ident">IntoIterator</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Item</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">attrs</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">attributes</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>()
                          .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">e</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">PullAttributeSpec</span>::<span class="ident">Attribute</span>(<span class="ident">PullConcreteAttribute</span>::<span class="ident">Entid</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>).<span class="ident">into</span>()))
                          .<span class="ident">collect</span>();
    <span class="ident">Puller</span>::<span class="ident">prepare</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">attrs</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>
        .<span class="ident">pull</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">db</span>, <span class="ident">once</span>(<span class="ident">entity</span>))
        .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">m</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">m</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>()
                  .<span class="ident">next</span>()
                  .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span>(<span class="ident">k</span>, <span class="ident">vs</span>)<span class="op">|</span> {
                      <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">k</span>, <span class="ident">entity</span>);
                      <span class="ident">vs</span>.<span class="ident">cloned</span>()
                  })
                  .<span class="ident">unwrap_or_else</span>(<span class="ident">StructuredMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>))
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">pull_attributes_for_entities</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">E</span>, <span class="ident">A</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>,
                                          <span class="ident">db</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>,
                                          <span class="ident">entities</span>: <span class="ident">E</span>,
                                          <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">A</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">PullResults</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>
    <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">E</span>: <span class="ident">IntoIterator</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Item</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,
          <span class="ident">A</span>: <span class="ident">IntoIterator</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Item</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">attrs</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">attributes</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>()
                          .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">e</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">PullAttributeSpec</span>::<span class="ident">Attribute</span>(<span class="ident">PullConcreteAttribute</span>::<span class="ident">Entid</span>(<span class="ident">e</span>).<span class="ident">into</span>()))
                          .<span class="ident">collect</span>();
    <span class="ident">Puller</span>::<span class="ident">prepare</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">attrs</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>
        .<span class="ident">pull</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="ident">db</span>, <span class="ident">entities</span>)
}

<span class="doccomment">/// A `Puller` constructs on demand a map from a provided set of entity IDs to a set of structured maps.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">Puller</span> {
    <span class="comment">// The domain of this map is the set of attributes to fetch.</span>
    <span class="comment">// The range is the set of aliases to use in the output.</span>
    <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">ValueRc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Keyword</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
    <span class="ident">attribute_spec</span>: <span class="ident">cache</span>::<span class="ident">AttributeSpec</span>,

    <span class="comment">// If this is set, each pulled entity is contributed to its own output map, labeled with this</span>
    <span class="comment">// keyword. This is a divergence from Datomic, which has no types by which to differentiate a</span>
    <span class="comment">// long from an entity ID, and thus represents all entities in pull as, _e.g._, `{:db/id 1234}`.</span>
    <span class="comment">//  Mentat can use `TypedValue::Ref(1234)`, but it&#39;s sometimes convenient to fetch the entity ID</span>
    <span class="comment">// itself as part of a pull expression: `{:person 1234, :person/name &quot;Peter&quot;}`.</span>
    <span class="ident">db_id_alias</span>: <span class="prelude-ty">Option</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueRc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Keyword</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">Puller</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">prepare</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>, <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">PullAttributeSpec</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Puller</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// TODO: eventually this entry point will handle aliasing and that kind of</span>
        <span class="comment">// thing. For now it&#39;s just a convenience.</span>

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">lookup_name</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">i</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">|</span> {
            <span class="comment">// In the unlikely event that we have an attribute with no name, we bail.</span>
            <span class="ident">schema</span>.<span class="ident">get_ident</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">i</span>)
                    .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">ident</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">ValueRc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">ident</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>()))
                    .<span class="ident">ok_or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">PullError</span>::<span class="ident">UnnamedAttribute</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">i</span>))
        };

        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">names</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span>, <span class="ident">ValueRc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Keyword</span><span class="op">&gt;&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">attrs</span>: <span class="ident">BTreeSet</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Default</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">db_id</span> <span class="op">=</span> ::<span class="ident">std</span>::<span class="ident">rc</span>::<span class="ident">Rc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">Keyword</span>::<span class="ident">namespaced</span>(<span class="string">&quot;db&quot;</span>, <span class="string">&quot;id&quot;</span>));
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">db_id_alias</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">None</span>;

        <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">attr</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">attributes</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
            <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">attr</span> {
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullAttributeSpec</span>::<span class="ident">Wildcard</span> <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">attribute_ids</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">schema</span>.<span class="ident">attribute_map</span>.<span class="ident">keys</span>();
                    <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">id</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">attribute_ids</span> {
                        <span class="ident">names</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">id</span>, <span class="ident">lookup_name</span>(<span class="ident">id</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>);
                        <span class="ident">attrs</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">id</span>);
                    }
                    <span class="kw">break</span>;
                },
                <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullAttributeSpec</span>::<span class="ident">Attribute</span>(<span class="ident">NamedPullAttribute</span> {
                    <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">attribute</span>,
                    <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">alias</span>,
                }) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">alias</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">alias</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>()
                                     .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">r</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">r</span>.<span class="ident">to_value_rc</span>());
                    <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">attribute</span> {
                        <span class="comment">// Handle :db/id.</span>
                        <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullConcreteAttribute</span>::<span class="ident">Ident</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">i</span>) <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">i</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>() <span class="op">==</span> <span class="ident">db_id</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>() <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                            <span class="comment">// We only allow :db/id once.</span>
                            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">db_id_alias</span>.<span class="ident">is_some</span>() {
                                <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">PullError</span>::<span class="ident">RepeatedDbId</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>
                            }
                            <span class="ident">db_id_alias</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">alias</span>.<span class="ident">unwrap_or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">db_id</span>.<span class="ident">to_value_rc</span>()));
                        },
                        <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullConcreteAttribute</span>::<span class="ident">Ident</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">i</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                            <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">schema</span>.<span class="ident">get_entid</span>(<span class="ident">i</span>) {
                                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">name</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">alias</span>.<span class="ident">unwrap_or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">i</span>.<span class="ident">to_value_rc</span>());
                                <span class="ident">names</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>(), <span class="ident">name</span>);
                                <span class="ident">attrs</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>());
                            }
                        },
                        <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">PullConcreteAttribute</span>::<span class="ident">Entid</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">entid</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                            <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">name</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">alias</span>.<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap_or_else</span>(<span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">lookup_name</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>))<span class="question-mark">?</span>;
                            <span class="ident">names</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">entid</span>, <span class="ident">name</span>);
                            <span class="ident">attrs</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">entid</span>);
                        },
                    }
                },
            }
        }

        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">Puller</span> {
            <span class="ident">attributes</span>: <span class="ident">names</span>,
            <span class="ident">attribute_spec</span>: <span class="ident">cache</span>::<span class="ident">AttributeSpec</span>::<span class="ident">specified</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">attrs</span>, <span class="ident">schema</span>),
            <span class="ident">db_id_alias</span>,
        })
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">pull</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">E</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>,
                   <span class="ident">schema</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Schema</span>,
                   <span class="ident">db</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>,
                   <span class="ident">entities</span>: <span class="ident">E</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">PullResults</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>
        <span class="kw">where</span> <span class="ident">E</span>: <span class="ident">IntoIterator</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Item</span><span class="op">=</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
        <span class="comment">// We implement pull by:</span>
        <span class="comment">// - Generating `AttributeCaches` for the provided attributes and entities.</span>
        <span class="comment">//   TODO: it would be nice to invert the cache as we build it, rather than have to invert it here.</span>
        <span class="comment">// - Recursing. (TODO: we&#39;ll need AttributeCaches to not overwrite in case of recursion! And</span>
        <span class="comment">//   ideally not do excess work when some entity/attribute pairs are known.)</span>
        <span class="comment">// - Building a structure by walking the pull expression with the caches.</span>
        <span class="comment">// TODO: limits.</span>

        <span class="comment">// Build a cache for these attributes and entities.</span>
        <span class="comment">// TODO: use the store&#39;s existing cache!</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">entities</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Entid</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">entities</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>().<span class="ident">collect</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">caches</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">cache</span>::<span class="ident">AttributeCaches</span>::<span class="ident">make_cache_for_entities_and_attributes</span>(
            <span class="ident">schema</span>,
            <span class="ident">db</span>,
            <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">attribute_spec</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(),
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">entities</span>)<span class="question-mark">?</span>;

        <span class="comment">// Now construct the appropriate result format.</span>
        <span class="comment">// TODO: should we walk `e` then `a`, or `a` then `e`? Possibly the right answer</span>
        <span class="comment">// is just to collect differently!</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">maps</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">BTreeMap</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>();

        <span class="comment">// Collect :db/id if requested.</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">alias</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">db_id_alias</span> {
            <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">e</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">entities</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">r</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">maps</span>.<span class="ident">entry</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">e</span>)
                                .<span class="ident">or_insert</span>(<span class="ident">ValueRc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">StructuredMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>()));
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">m</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ValueRc</span>::<span class="ident">get_mut</span>(<span class="ident">r</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
                <span class="ident">m</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">alias</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">Binding</span>::<span class="ident">Scalar</span>(<span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Ref</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">e</span>)));
            }
        }

        <span class="kw">for</span> (<span class="ident">name</span>, <span class="ident">cache</span>) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">attributes</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>().<span class="ident">filter_map</span>(<span class="op">|</span>(<span class="ident">a</span>, <span class="ident">name</span>)<span class="op">|</span>
            <span class="ident">caches</span>.<span class="ident">forward_attribute_cache_for_attribute</span>(<span class="ident">schema</span>, <span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">a</span>)
                  .<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">cache</span><span class="op">|</span> (<span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">cache</span>))) {

            <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">e</span> <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="ident">entities</span>.<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">binding</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">cache</span>.<span class="ident">binding_for_e</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">e</span>) {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">r</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">maps</span>.<span class="ident">entry</span>(<span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="ident">e</span>)
                                    .<span class="ident">or_insert</span>(<span class="ident">ValueRc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">StructuredMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>()));

                    <span class="comment">// Get into the inner map so we can accumulate a value.</span>
                    <span class="comment">// We can unwrap here because we created all of these maps…</span>
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">m</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">ValueRc</span>::<span class="ident">get_mut</span>(<span class="ident">r</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();

                    <span class="ident">m</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">binding</span>);
                }
            }
        }

        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(<span class="ident">maps</span>)
    }

}
</pre>
</section>

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">derive</span>(<span class="ident">Debug</span>, <span class="ident">Fail</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">enum</span> <span class="ident">SQLError</span> {
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">fail</span>(<span class="ident">display</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">&quot;invalid parameter name: {}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">_0</span>)]</span>
    <span class="ident">InvalidParameterName</span>(<span class="ident">String</span>),

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">fail</span>(<span class="ident">display</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">&quot;parameter name could be generated: &#39;{}&#39;&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">_0</span>)]</span>
    <span class="ident">BindParamCouldBeGenerated</span>(<span class="ident">String</span>)
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">type</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(), <span class="ident">SQLError</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>;

<span class="doccomment">/// We want to accumulate values that will later be substituted into a SQL statement execution.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// This struct encapsulates the generated string and the _initial_ argument list.</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// Additional user-supplied argument bindings, with their placeholders accumulated via</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// `push_bind_param`, will be appended to this argument list.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">SQLQuery</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>,

    <span class="doccomment">/// These will eventually perhaps be rusqlite `ToSql` instances.</span>
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">args</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>,
}

<span class="doccomment">/// Gratefully based on Diesel&#39;s QueryBuilder trait:</span>
<span class="doccomment">/// https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/blob/4885f61b8205f7f3c2cfa03837ed6714831abe6b/diesel/src/query_builder/mod.rs#L56</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>);
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_identifier</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">identifier</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_typed_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_bind_param</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">name</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span>;
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">finish</span>(<span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">SQLQuery</span>;
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">trait</span> <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">out</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span>;
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">Box</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">QueryFragment</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">out</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span>::<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">out</span>)
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;a</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;a</span> <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">out</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span>::<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="kw-2">*</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">out</span>)
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">QueryFragment</span> <span class="kw">for</span> () {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">_out</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }
}

<span class="doccomment">/// A QueryBuilder that implements SQLite&#39;s specific escaping rules.</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">struct</span> <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>,

    <span class="ident">arg_prefix</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>,
    <span class="ident">arg_counter</span>: <span class="ident">i64</span>,

    <span class="comment">// We can&#39;t just use an InternSet on the rusqlite::types::Value instances, because that</span>
    <span class="comment">// includes f64, so it&#39;s not Hash or Eq.</span>
    <span class="comment">// Instead we track byte and String arguments separately, mapping them to their argument name,</span>
    <span class="comment">// in order to dedupe. We&#39;ll add these to the regular argument vector later.</span>
    <span class="ident">byte_args</span>: <span class="ident">HashMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">u8</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">String</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,             <span class="comment">// From value to argument name.</span>
    <span class="ident">string_args</span>: <span class="ident">HashMap</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">ValueRc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">String</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="ident">String</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>,   <span class="comment">// From value to argument name.</span>
    <span class="ident">args</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>(<span class="ident">String</span>, <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>)<span class="op">&gt;</span>, <span class="comment">// (arg, value).</span>
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span> {
    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">new</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span>::<span class="ident">with_prefix</span>(<span class="string">&quot;$v&quot;</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>())
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">with_prefix</span>(<span class="ident">prefix</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="self">Self</span> {
        <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span> {
            <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="ident">String</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(),
            <span class="ident">arg_prefix</span>: <span class="ident">prefix</span>,
            <span class="ident">arg_counter</span>: <span class="number">0</span>,

            <span class="ident">byte_args</span>: <span class="ident">HashMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">string_args</span>: <span class="ident">HashMap</span>::<span class="ident">default</span>(),
            <span class="ident">args</span>: <span class="macro">vec</span><span class="macro">!</span>[],
        }
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">next_argument_name</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">String</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">arg</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{}{}&quot;</span>, <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_prefix</span>, <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_counter</span>);
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_counter</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_counter</span> <span class="op">+</span> <span class="number">1</span>;
        <span class="ident">arg</span>
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_static_arg</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">val</span>: <span class="ident">Rc</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span><span class="op">&gt;</span>) {
        <span class="comment">// TODO: intern these, too.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">arg</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">next_argument_name</span>();
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">push</span>((<span class="ident">arg</span>, <span class="ident">val</span>));
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">arg</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>);
    }
}

<span class="kw">impl</span> <span class="ident">QueryBuilder</span> <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span> {
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">sql</span>.<span class="ident">push_str</span>(<span class="ident">sql</span>);
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_identifier</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">identifier</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot;`&quot;</span>);
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">identifier</span>.<span class="ident">replace</span>(<span class="string">&quot;`&quot;</span>, <span class="string">&quot;``&quot;</span>));
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot;`&quot;</span>);
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_typed_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">value</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
        <span class="kw">match</span> <span class="ident">value</span> {
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Ref</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="ident">entid</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>().<span class="ident">as_str</span>()),
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Boolean</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">v</span> { <span class="string">&quot;1&quot;</span> } <span class="kw">else</span> { <span class="string">&quot;0&quot;</span> }),
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Long</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>().<span class="ident">as_str</span>()),
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Double</span>(<span class="ident">OrderedFloat</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>)) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="comment">// Rust&#39;s floats print without a trailing &#39;.&#39; in some cases.</span>
                <span class="comment">// https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/30967</span>
                <span class="comment">// We format with &#39;e&#39; -- scientific notation -- so that SQLite treats them as</span>
                <span class="comment">// floats and not integers. This is most noticeable for fulltext scores, which</span>
                <span class="comment">// will currently (2017-06) always be 0, and need to round-trip as doubles.</span>
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{:e}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">v</span>).<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Instant</span>(<span class="ident">dt</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="macro">format</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="string">&quot;{}&quot;</span>, <span class="ident">dt</span>.<span class="ident">to_micros</span>()).<span class="ident">as_str</span>());      <span class="comment">// TODO: argument instead?</span>
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Uuid</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">u</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">bytes</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">u</span>.<span class="ident">as_bytes</span>();
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">byte_args</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="ident">bytes</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>()).<span class="ident">cloned</span>() {        <span class="comment">// Why, borrow checker, why?!</span>
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">arg</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">next_argument_name</span>();
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">byte_args</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">bytes</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>().<span class="ident">to_vec</span>(), <span class="ident">arg</span>);
                }
            },
            <span class="comment">// These are both `Rc`. Unfortunately, we can&#39;t use that fact when</span>
            <span class="comment">// turning these into rusqlite Values.</span>
            <span class="comment">// However, we can check to see whether there&#39;s an existing var that matches…</span>
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">String</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">s</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="prelude-val">Some</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>) <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">string_args</span>.<span class="ident">get</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>).<span class="ident">cloned</span>() {
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
                } <span class="kw">else</span> {
                    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">arg</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">next_argument_name</span>();
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_named_arg</span>(<span class="ident">arg</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>());
                    <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">string_args</span>.<span class="ident">insert</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">clone</span>(), <span class="ident">arg</span>);
                }
            },
            <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">Keyword</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">s</span>) <span class="op">=&gt;</span> {
                <span class="comment">// TODO: intern.</span>
                <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">v</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">Rc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Text</span>(<span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>().<span class="ident">to_string</span>()));
                <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_static_arg</span>(<span class="ident">v</span>);
            },
        }
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }

    <span class="doccomment">/// Our bind parameters will be interleaved with pushed `TypedValue` instances. That means we</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// need to use named parameters, not positional parameters.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// The `name` argument to this method is expected to be alphanumeric. If not, this method</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// returns an `InvalidParameterName` error result.</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// Callers should make sure that the name doesn&#39;t overlap with generated parameter names. If</span>
    <span class="doccomment">/// it does, `BindParamCouldBeGenerated` is the error.</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">push_bind_param</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="self">self</span>, <span class="ident">name</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">BuildQueryResult</span> {
        <span class="comment">// Do some validation first.</span>
        <span class="comment">// This is not free, but it&#39;s probably worth it for now.</span>
        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="op">!</span><span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">chars</span>().<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="ident">c</span><span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">char</span>::<span class="ident">is_alphanumeric</span>(<span class="ident">c</span>) <span class="op">||</span> <span class="ident">c</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="string">&#39;_&#39;</span>) {
            <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">SQLError</span>::<span class="ident">InvalidParameterName</span>(<span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>()))
        }

        <span class="kw">if</span> <span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">starts_with</span>(<span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_prefix</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>()) <span class="op">&amp;&amp;</span>
           <span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">chars</span>().<span class="ident">skip</span>(<span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">arg_prefix</span>.<span class="ident">len</span>()).<span class="ident">all</span>(<span class="ident">char</span>::<span class="ident">is_numeric</span>) {
               <span class="kw">return</span> <span class="prelude-val">Err</span>(<span class="ident">SQLError</span>::<span class="ident">BindParamCouldBeGenerated</span>(<span class="ident">name</span>.<span class="ident">to_string</span>()))
        }

        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot;$&quot;</span>);
        <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="ident">name</span>);
        <span class="prelude-val">Ok</span>(())
    }

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">finish</span>(<span class="self">self</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">SQLQuery</span> {
        <span class="comment">// We collected string and byte arguments into separate maps so that we could</span>
        <span class="comment">// dedupe them. Now we need to turn them into rusqlite Values.</span>
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">args</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">args</span>;
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">string_args</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">string_args</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>().<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>, <span class="ident">arg</span>)<span class="op">|</span> {
             (<span class="ident">arg</span>, <span class="ident">Rc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Text</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>.<span class="ident">as_ref</span>().<span class="ident">clone</span>())))
        });
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">byte_args</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">byte_args</span>.<span class="ident">into_iter</span>().<span class="ident">map</span>(<span class="op">|</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>, <span class="ident">arg</span>)<span class="op">|</span> {
            (<span class="ident">arg</span>, <span class="ident">Rc</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>(<span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">types</span>::<span class="ident">Value</span>::<span class="ident">Blob</span>(<span class="ident">val</span>)))
        });

        <span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">extend</span>(<span class="ident">string_args</span>);
        <span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">extend</span>(<span class="ident">byte_args</span>);

        <span class="comment">// Get the args in the right order -- $v0, $v1…</span>
        <span class="ident">args</span>.<span class="ident">sort_by</span>(<span class="op">|</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">k1</span>, <span class="kw">_</span>), <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>(<span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">k2</span>, <span class="kw">_</span>)<span class="op">|</span> <span class="ident">k1</span>.<span class="ident">cmp</span>(<span class="ident">k2</span>));
        <span class="ident">SQLQuery</span> {
            <span class="ident">sql</span>: <span class="self">self</span>.<span class="ident">sql</span>,
            <span class="ident">args</span>: <span class="ident">args</span>,
        }
    }
}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">tests</span> {

    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">test</span>]</span>
    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">test_sql</span>() {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">s</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">SQLiteQueryBuilder</span>::<span class="ident">new</span>();
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot;SELECT &quot;</span>);

        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot; WHERE &quot;</span>);

        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot; = &quot;</span>);
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_static_arg</span>(<span class="ident">string_arg</span>(<span class="string">&quot;frobnicate&quot;</span>));
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot; OR &quot;</span>);
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_static_arg</span>(<span class="ident">string_arg</span>(<span class="string">&quot;swoogle&quot;</span>));
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot; OR &quot;</span>);
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_identifier</span>(<span class="string">&quot;bar&quot;</span>).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_sql</span>(<span class="string">&quot; = &quot;</span>);
        <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">push_typed_value</span>(<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">TypedValue</span>::<span class="ident">Double</span>(<span class="number">1.0</span>.<span class="ident">into</span>())).<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">q</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">s</span>.<span class="ident">finish</span>();

        <span class="macro">assert_eq</span><span class="macro">!</span>(<span class="ident">q</span>.<span class="ident">sql</span>.<span class="ident">as_str</span>(), <span class="string">&quot;SELECT `foo` WHERE `bar` = $v0 OR $v1 OR `bar` = 1e0&quot;</span>);

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">static</span> <span class="ident">REMOTE_HEAD_KEY</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">str</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="string">r#&quot;remote_head&quot;#</span>;

<span class="macro">lazy_static</span><span class="macro">!</span> {
    <span class="doccomment">/// SQL statements to be executed, in order, to create the Tolstoy SQL schema (version 1).</span>
    <span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg_attr</span>(<span class="ident">rustfmt</span>, <span class="ident">rustfmt_skip</span>)]</span>
    <span class="kw">static</span> <span class="kw-2">ref</span> <span class="ident">SCHEMA_STATEMENTS</span>: <span class="ident">Vec</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="lifetime">&#39;static</span> <span class="ident">str</span><span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="op">=</span> { <span class="macro">vec</span><span class="macro">!</span>[
        <span class="string">r#&quot;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tolstoy_tu (tx INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uuid BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE) WITHOUT ROWID&quot;#</span>,
        <span class="string">r#&quot;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tolstoy_metadata (key BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE, value BLOB NOT NULL)&quot;#</span>,
        <span class="string">r#&quot;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tolstoy_tu_ut ON tolstoy_tu (uuid, tx)&quot;#</span>,
        ]
    };
}

<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">ensure_current_version</span>(<span class="ident">conn</span>: <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="kw-2">mut</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>) <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="prelude-ty">Result</span><span class="op">&lt;</span>()<span class="op">&gt;</span> {
    <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">tx</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">conn</span>.<span class="ident">transaction</span>()<span class="question-mark">?</span>;

    <span class="kw">for</span> <span class="ident">statement</span> <span class="kw">in</span> (<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">SCHEMA_STATEMENTS</span>).<span class="ident">iter</span>() {
        <span class="ident">tx</span>.<span class="ident">execute</span>(<span class="ident">statement</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>[])<span class="question-mark">?</span>;

    <span class="ident">tx</span>.<span class="ident">execute</span>(<span class="string">&quot;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tolstoy_metadata (key, value) VALUES (?, zeroblob(16))&quot;</span>, <span class="kw-2">&amp;</span>[<span class="kw-2">&amp;</span><span class="ident">REMOTE_HEAD_KEY</span>])<span class="question-mark">?</span>;

}

<span class="attribute">#[<span class="ident">cfg</span>(<span class="ident">test</span>)]</span>
<span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">mod</span> <span class="ident">tests</span> {
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="kw">super</span>::<span class="kw-2">*</span>;
    <span class="kw">use</span> <span class="ident">uuid</span>::<span class="ident">Uuid</span>;

    <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">setup_conn_bare</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span> {
        <span class="kw">let</span> <span class="ident">conn</span> <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span>::<span class="ident">open_in_memory</span>().<span class="ident">unwrap</span>();

        <span class="ident">conn</span>.<span class="ident">execute_batch</span>(<span class="string">&quot;
            PRAGMA page_size=32768;
            PRAGMA journal_mode=wal;
            PRAGMA wal_autocheckpoint=32;
            PRAGMA journal_size_limit=3145728;
            PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
        &quot;</span>).<span class="ident">expect</span>(<span class="string">&quot;success&quot;</span>);

        <span class="ident">conn</span>
    }

    <span class="kw">pub</span> <span class="kw">fn</span> <span class="ident">setup_conn</span>() <span class="op">-&gt;</span> <span class="ident">rusqlite</span>::<span class="ident">Connection</span> {
